title: Operations Manager - UK Serviced Accommodation (13 Properties) - Run Our Whole Operation
description:
Luxstay Ventures is a UK serviced accommodation company managing 13 short-stay rental properties across Brighton, Watford, and Leicester. We host guests on Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and direct. We manage properties for owners and JV partners.



We are hiring an Operations Manager to OWN our daily operations end to end. This is not a task-taking VA role. You will run the operation. The director is stepping back from day-to-day operations to focus on growth, and we need someone who can hold the whole thing together: guests, cleaners, standards, maintenance, and reporting, across all 13 properties, without being told what to do each day.



You will have a full operations manual, video training, and a clear escalation framework from day one. If you are the kind of person who builds systems, closes loops, and takes genuine ownership, you will thrive here and grow with us as we scale toward 20+ properties.



-- THE SKILLS THAT MATTER MOST FOR THIS ROLE --



Quality control with evidence. You enforce property standards using checklists and photo proof. You work to a clear "definition of done" for every turnover. You do not accept "it's cleaned" without verification.



Root-cause problem solving. When an issue comes up, you do not just log it and move on. You resolve it fully and prevent it from happening again. You keep an issues and defects log and you close items properly.



Calm guest resolution under pressure. You handle complaints and difficult guests with a professional, calm tone. You know when to reassure, when to offer a solution, and critically, when to escalate to the director instead of acting alone.



Time-critical claim handling. You understand that damage claims and disputes have strict deadlines (AirCover is 14 days from checkout, before the next guest; guest complaints need a response within 24 hours). You move fast to gather photo evidence and protect the business. Experience with AirCover, Resolution Centre, or chargeback evidence is a strong advantage.



Running a cadence. You work to a daily and weekly rhythm. You know what gets checked every morning, what gets reported every week, and you keep the operation moving without drift.



Multi-property organisation. You can hold 13 properties in your head at once and make sure nothing slips. You have a system for this, not just good intentions.



-- WHAT YOU WILL OWN --



Guest Communications: All guest messages across all 13 properties and all channels. Fast, professional responses. Full guest journey from enquiry to post-checkout.



Cleaning Team Management: You manage our cleaning teams directly (Watford, Brighton, Leicester). Confirm every turnover. Verify photo checklists in Turno after every clean. Chase incomplete cleans. You are the bridge between us and the cleaners.



Property Standards and QA: Enforce standards with checklists and photo evidence. Maintain the issues log. Drive recurring problems to zero.



Maintenance Coordination: When something breaks, you own the fix. Contact contractors, schedule the repair, follow up until it is closed, keep the director informed. You coordinate this remotely using our on-the-ground cleaners and contractors.



Reviews and Reputation: Monitor and respond to all guest reviews. Draft responses for approval where needed. Flag negatives immediately and help protect our rating. One of our properties needs rating recovery and you will help lead that.



Reporting: Daily operations summary to the director. Weekly performance report covering occupancy, issues, cleaning status, and guest feedback.



-- WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO --

Change pricing, rates, or minimum stays (handled separately, view-only access)

Bookkeeping or Xero (we have a dedicated bookkeeper)

Approve refunds or cancellations without director sign-off

Communicate with property owners or investors (director handles this)

Cold sales or outreach



-- TOOLS (full training provided) --

Uplisting (channel manager), Turno (cleaning + photo verification), PriceLabs (view only), Slack (team comms), WhatsApp (cleaner coordination), Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Google Calendar



-- REQUIREMENTS --

At least 3 years in short-term rental or serviced accommodation operations

Proven experience managing or coordinating cleaning teams and contractors

Hands-on experience with a channel manager (Uplisting, Guesty, Hostaway, Hostfully, or similar)

Demonstrable experience resolving guest complaints and disputes independently

Strong written English with a calm, professional, friendly tone

Genuinely organised and proactive. You run things, you do not wait to be told

WhatsApp on your phone, reliable internet, laptop with Chrome



-- STRONG ADVANTAGE --

Experience managing 10+ properties simultaneously

Experience with AirCover claims, Airbnb Resolution Centre, or chargeback evidence

Experience with Turno or similar photo-verification cleaning software

Experience training or managing other VAs (we will scale and you may build a team under you)

UK market experience



-- COMPENSATION --

$720 USD per month for full-time (40 hours/week)

Paid monthly via Tap Tap Send

13th month bonus in December

30-day performance review

Clear growth path: as we scale toward 20+ properties, this role grows in pay and responsibility, potentially building and leading an operations team under you



-- HOW ONBOARDING WORKS --

Week 1: Watch the Loom training library, read the operations manual, meet the cleaning teams, shadow how we work. You learn before you act.

Week 2: You take on guest messaging and cleaning verification with the director reviewing your work daily.

Weeks 3-4: You take full ownership of daily operations. The director reviews your daily summary.

This is a 30-day paid trial. If we are both happy, this becomes a permanent senior role.



-- TO APPLY --

Answer ALL FOUR questions. Generic or copy-paste applications will be deleted unread.



1. A guest at our Brighton property messages at 10am: "there is mould in the bathroom, this is disgusting, I want a refund or I am leaving a 1-star review." Walk me through exactly what you do, who you contact, what you say to the guest, and in what order.



2. You check Turno after a checkout and the cleaner has uploaded no photos. The next guest checks in at 3pm. It is now 11am. Walk me through your exact next steps.



3. A guest checks out and you discover they have damaged a bed. Walk me through what you do to make sure we can actually recover the cost. Be specific about timing and evidence.



4. You are running 13 properties at once. Describe the actual system or daily routine you use to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Tell me about a real system you have used before, not what you would do in theory.



In your first line, tell me the most properties you have managed at one time, and the channel manager you have used most.

title: Account Manager
description:
About Rockenue

Rockenue is a technology-powered commercial management company for hotels. We handle revenue management, distribution, sales, and tech implementation for a growing portfolio of properties across Europe.



We're looking for someone with energy, hunger, and common sense — not necessarily a long CV.

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of hotel accounts, acting as the day-to-day point of contact for property partners. You'll produce reports, manage distribution channels, solve problems, and keep everything running smoothly. We'll teach you the hospitality side. What we can't teach is drive, initiative, and the ability to figure things out.

If you're the kind of person who Googles the answer before asking the question, who takes pride in getting things right, and who genuinely gets a buzz from being on top of everything — keep reading.



What You'll Be Doing



Managing a portfolio of hotel accounts end-to-end, acting as the main point of contact for property owners and managers

Producing and delivering regular performance reports to clients

Working inside OTA extranets (
, Expedia, etc.), channel managers, and property management systems daily

Monitoring rate parity, availability, and distribution health across all channels

Coordinating with the internal team on pricing updates, promotions, and new channel activations

Identifying revenue opportunities and flagging underperformance

Using AI tools, chatbots, and automation to streamline workflows and increase output

Learning and mastering new hospitality tech platforms quickly





Who You Are (This Matters More Than Your CV)



Relentless work ethic. You take ownership. You don't clock-watch. When something needs doing, you do it — properly and fast.

Common sense over credentials. You can walk into an unfamiliar situation, assess it logically, and figure out the right move without being hand-held.

Tech-obsessed, not tech-tolerant. You genuinely enjoy learning new systems. Complex dashboards and unfamiliar software excite you rather than intimidate you.

AI is already part of your workflow. You actively use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to get more done. This isn't optional — it's central to how we work.

Proactive by nature. You spot problems before they're reported. You suggest improvements nobody asked for. You hate sitting idle.

Clear communicator. Excellent written and verbal English. You can explain something simply, flag an issue professionally, and keep a client confident.

Detail-oriented without losing the big picture. You catch the small errors but still understand why they matter commercially.



Hospitality experience is a plus but absolutely not required. If you've never touched a hotel extranet but you're sharp, motivated, and learn fast — we want to hear from you. We will train the right person.



Application Requirements

Your application must include a short video introduction (2–3 minutes) covering:



Who you are and a bit about your background

Why you'd be a great fit for Rockenue specifically

A brief example of how you use AI or automation tools in your current or recent work



Applications without a video will not be considered. This is the single most important part of your application — show us your energy and personality.



Compensation

Competitive monthly salary (paid in GBP/USD), commensurate with experience. Long-term position with real room to grow as the portfolio scales.

We are looking for a talented, creative short-form video editor who can take our raw footage and turn it into scroll-stopping, share-worthy content for Instagram Reels,
, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is a fully remote, part-time contract position paid at a flat rate of $200 per month.

We produce a high volume of original content — luxury home tours, community lifestyle videos, interior design videos, reviews, and talking-head educational content — and we need an editor who can make every video feel cinematic, exciting, and completely impossible to scroll past.

In your application, please tell us exactly how many high-quality videos you can deliver per month at this rate. We want to understand what you can realistically produce at your best — not a rushed, high-volume output, but genuinely excellent work that makes people stop, watch, and share.



Who We Are

We are a luxury real estate team based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, specializing in new construction homes, Avenir, and the surrounding communities. We create original video content constantly and have a growing YouTube channel, Instagram presence, and social media following. Our brand is professional, warm, and aspirational — and our videos need to reflect that at the highest level.



What You Will Be Doing



Editing raw video footage into polished, high-energy 1–3 minute short-form videos optimized for Reels, Shorts,
, TikTok, and LinkedIn

Adding cinematic titles, lower thirds, and text overlays that are visually stunning — not generic templates

Incorporating music, sound design, and audio mixing that makes the video feel professional and exciting

Color grading footage to a consistent, premium aesthetic that matches our luxury brand

Creating motion graphics, animated transitions, and visual effects that elevate the content above standard real estate videos

Using AI video tools, AI-enhanced graphics, or generative effects where appropriate to create genuinely wow-worthy 
nts

Cutting talking-head content in a dynamic way — removing dead air, adding B-roll cutaways, keeping energy high throughout

Delivering files optimized for each platform — correct aspect ratios, captions, thumbnail suggestions

Accepting revision requests professionally and turning around changes quickly

Occasionally creating simple thumbnail graphics or cover images for YouTube and social media





What We Are Looking For



A strong portfolio of short-form video edits — specifically Reels, Shorts, or TikTok content — that demonstrate genuine creativity and technical skill

Proficiency in professional editing software — Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent

Experience with motion graphics tools — After Effects, CapCut Pro, or similar

Knowledge of AI video tools, AI-enhanced visuals, or generative content is a significant advantage — we want someone who is staying current with what is possible

Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, and storytelling — you understand what makes someone keep watching versus scroll away

Understanding of social media platform requirements — aspect ratios, caption placement, hook-based editing structure

Real estate, luxury lifestyle, or property video experience is a plus but not required

Reliable, responsive, and able to meet agreed turnaround times consistently

Proactive creative input — we want someone who brings ideas, not just executes instructions





What Makes This Role Special

We are not looking for someone to churn out average content. We are building a brand that stands out in the Palm Beach County luxury real estate market and we need a video editor who takes genuine pride in making something extraordinary. If you are the kind of editor who gets excited about a great color grade, a perfectly timed cut, or a title animation that stops someone mid-scroll — this is your role.

We are also a growing brand which means this relationship has real long-term potential. The right editor who delivers outstanding work will have the opportunity to grow with us as our content volume and budget increase.



The Important Question — Tell Us What You Can Deliver

Our budget is $200 per month flat rate. We are realistic — we understand that exceptional work takes time. In your application, please answer this directly:

At $200 per month, how many truly excellent 1–3 minute short-form videos can you realistically deliver? What does your process look like and what is your typical turnaround time per video?





Compensation



$200 per month — flat rate regardless of exact hours

Fully remote — work from anywhere

Flexible schedule — you manage your own time, we manage the deadline

Potential for increased budget as the relationship grows and results are proven



We review every application and respond to serious candidates personally. Please do not apply if you cannot show us actual examples of your work — a portfolio is required.

title: Virtual Assistant / Executive Right-Hand — Fast-Growing LA Auto Brokerage
description:
Virtual Assistant / Executive Right-Hand — Fast-Growing LA Auto Brokerage

Full-time | Remote | Long-term role for the right person

About Us

We're Apex Auto Leasing, a licensed auto brokerage based in Los Angeles. In plain English: we make buying and leasing cars easy. People come to us when they want a new lease, want to buy a specific car, or want to sell the one they have — and we handle everything. We find them the right car, negotiate the best price, and get it delivered to their door. We're growing fast and building a team, and I'm looking for one sharp, hungry person to become my right hand and help me scale.

About the Role

This is not a "do one small task" job. I'm looking for someone who can become my go-to person — someone I can hand things to and trust they'll get done right, without me babysitting. You'll touch almost every part of my day-to-day, but two areas matter most:

1. Finding leads (clients). Helping me find people who want to buy, lease, or sell a car — through research, online marketplaces, social media, and lead generation. You need to actually know how to do this.

2. Finding talent (salespeople). This is one of my biggest priorities. I'm building a team of salespeople, and I need help finding experienced people who already work at car dealerships. You'll research dealership websites and LinkedIn, build organized lists of salespeople with their contact info, and help me identify the ones most likely to be hungry and want a better opportunity. You'll help me draft and organize outreach (I approve everything before it goes out).

If you can consistently bring me good leads AND good potential hires, you become irreplaceable to me — and I'll take care of you for it.

What You'll Do Day-to-Day

Lead research & generation — finding potential car clients across online sources

Recruiting research — building lists of dealership salespeople (name, role, contact info, LinkedIn) and flagging the strongest candidates

Content & design in Canva — turning my car deals into clean social media posts, stories, and reels using my brand style

Social media management — scheduling and posting daily deals and content to Instagram (consistency is everything)

CRM & automation — entering and organizing leads, building and maintaining workflows

Vehicle research — looking up car specs, trims, and inventory when I'm working a deal

General assistant work — whatever helps me move faster

Quick note before you keep reading, because I only want people who actually read: when you apply, the very first word of your message must be the word APEX. I'm putting this instruction right here in the middle on purpose. If you skim job posts and skip to the bottom, you'll miss it — and if you miss it, your application gets deleted without a second look. I need someone with attention to detail, and this is how I find them.

Requirements (You Must Have These)

These are not "nice to haves." If you can't do these, please don't apply:

Excellent written AND spoken English. This is my single biggest requirement. You'll be writing messages, building lists I read every day, and possibly communicating on my behalf. Your English needs to be clean, professional, and natural-sounding. I will be testing for this directly, so don't apply if this isn't a real strength.

Strong Canva skills. You can design clean, professional graphics on your own without hand-holding.

Lead generation / online research ability. You know how to find people and information online that others can't.

Recruiting, sourcing, or list-building experience. You can build organized, accurate contact lists from scratch.

CRM & automation experience — GoHighLevel, 
, or similar tools. You can set these up and make them work, not just click around.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and a self-starter. I'll give you direction, but I need someone who takes initiative — not someone I have to chase.

Hungry and reliable. I want someone who gives 110% every day and genuinely cares about doing great work. I'm building something big, and I want someone who grows with me.

Big Plus — This Could Make You My Top Pick

If you have experience in sales or the car/automotive industry, you move straight to the top of my list. Someone who understands selling and understands cars is exactly the kind of person I want next to me. If that's you, make sure I know it.

Bonus on top of that:

Appointment setting experience

Basic video editing for reels

Details

Schedule: Full-time, with working hours overlapping US Pacific Time (Los Angeles)

Pay: Competitive — and I reward results. The better you perform, the more this role and your pay grow.

Long-term: I'm not looking for someone temporary. I want to find one great person and build a long relationship.

How to Apply

I read every application that follows the instructions — and ignore the ones that don't. To be considered:

Follow the instruction I hid earlier in this post. (If you read the whole thing, you already know what to do.)

In a few sentences, tell me about a time you found something or someone online that other people couldn't — show me your research skills.

Send me 2 examples of Canva designs you've made.

Tell me whether you have any sales or car-industry experience.

Tell me which of my two priorities — finding leads or finding salespeople — you'd be stronger at, and why.

If you're sharp, you speak great English, and you actually want to grow with a business instead of just collecting a paycheck — I want to hear from you.

description:
Operations & Sales Manager — Aqua Home Supply

Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time Base: $1,500 USD/month + Uncapped Commission





About Aqua Home Supply

Aqua Home Supply is a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in water treatment products. We move fast, we take customer experience seriously, and we're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and runs with it.





The Role

We're hiring an Operations & Sales Manager to own the day-to-day execution of our order fulfillment, vendor relationships, and customer operations. This is a critical role — you are the operational backbone of the business.



This is not a task-taker position. We need someone who identifies problems before they become fires, communicates proactively, follows through without reminders, and takes genuine pride in running a clean operation.



If that sounds like you, keep reading.





What You'll Own

Order Management & Fulfillment



Review the full order tracking queue daily — flag delays, contact vendors proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

Process approved orders accurately and on time

Manage open orders through to delivery confirmation (~150 orders/month)



Vendor Relations



All vendor communication runs through you — order status, delays, damage claims, cancellations, return authorizations, missing parts, and custom quotes

Build and maintain professional vendor relationships

Document every vendor interaction in the order record, same day



Customer Operations



Handle inbound sales inquiries under $4,000 — build quotes in Shopify and follow up via HubSpot

Manage escalated support tickets from our CS team via Zendesk

Respond to all direct customer
s within 24 hours

Ensure every customer is acknowledged before any ticket is escalated internally



Returns & Claims



Determine return eligibility, who covers shipping, and coordinate logistics

Request return authorizations from vendors and relay instructions to the CS team

Manage freight broker relationships for oversized returns

Track all open claims and follow up with vendors within 1–2 business days



Reporting & Admin



Prepare aged order summaries for weekly management review

Follow up on open HubSpot deals and unconverted quotes



Team Supervision



Daily check-in with our CS Reps — review the ticket backlog, flag stuck tickets, confirm nothing is sitting unaddressed

Give direct feedback to the CS Reps and escalate performance concerns when needed





What We're Looking For

Proven e-commerce or retail operations experience — you've managed orders, vendors, and customer issues before and you know what good looks like

Obsessive follow-through — things don't fall through the cracks on your watch

Detail orientation — you catch errors before they ship, not after

Proactive communication — you flag problems before deadlines, not after

Self-management — you don't need reminders to complete recurring tasks

Strong written English — you're communicating with US customers and vendors daily

Experience with Zendesk, Shopify, and/or HubSpot is a strong plus





What This Is Not

This role is not for someone who needs constant direction, waits to be asked before taking action, or lets aged issues sit without follow-up. We've built detailed SOPs and you'll have full support — but we need someone who executes independently and owns outcomes.





Compensation & Schedule

Base Salary: $1,500 USD/month

Commission: Earned on closed sales — uncapped. Top performers significantly exceed base pay.

Schedule: Full-time, aligned to US business hours

Location: Remote — Philippines-based candidates only





To Apply

Read these instructions carefully — they are part of the application process.



Subject Line: Your application must include the following subject line exactly as written: "AHS Ops — I Read Everything". Applications submitted without this exact subject line will be immediately discarded, no exceptions.



Your submission must include all three of the following:



Your CV/resume



A personalized video — record a short video (1-2 minutes) addressed specifically to Aqua Home Supply. Tell us who you are, what you know about our business, and why you believe you are the right fit for this role. Generic videos that could have been recorded for any company will not be considered. The video must mention Aqua Home Supply by name.



A written note — not a template, not a cover letter. A brief, specific paragraph telling us about an operational problem you personally identified and solved in a previous role. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the outcome?



Applications missing any of these three elements will be discarded without review. We are looking for someone who follows instructions precisely and pays attention to detail — this process is the first test of exactly that.

title: TikTok Shop Operator — Build & Run a US-Backed Affiliate Business (Base + Profit Share + Year-End Bonus)
description:
Compensation at a glance

$1,500/month base, paid weekly via Wise (guaranteed floor)

25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped

15% override on the net production of any helpers we hire under you

10% year-end bonus on your annual personal Net Profit, paid every January 31



Real comp examples: $2,750/mo at $5K NP · $5,250/mo at $15K NP · $9,000/mo at $30K NP (full math + worked example in the Compensation section below)



This pays 2–3x what every comparable TikTok Shop role on OnlineJobs.ph offers. Keep reading to see why we can pay this and what we expect in return.





Essentially: you are building an entire TikTok Shop affiliate company from the ground up, with full financial backing and US LLC infrastructure provided by us. You bring the operational skill. We bring the capital, legal structure, and US-side resources.





About this role: 

This is not a typical VA role. This is a lead operator role for someone who wants to build a real TikTok Shop affiliate business and earn like a senior tea
mber with real upside, not a flat-rate VA.



We're a US-based holding company launching a TikTok Shop affiliate operation. We provide the infrastructure — US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US-resident device/IP setup, US shipping addresses, working capital, and TikTok Shop seller verification. You build and run the operation. Product research, account warming, scripts, content production, posting, optimization, scaling. When the time is right, you propose new hires and we approve, fund, and onboard them under our LLC — and you earn a cut of what they produce.



You're the operator on the ground. The owner is hands-on with strategy, sets all base pay, approves all hires and fires, and owns final say on direction. You drive execution day-to-day with real autonomy inside that framework.



If you've ever run a successful TikTok Shop account and thought "I should be doing this with a real company behind me instead of $2/hr for an agency" — this is that opportunity, with the US LLC infrastructure already solved.



What success looks like

Month 1: Two TikTok Shop accounts warmed and posting 5+ videos/day each, with first commission revenue landed

Month 3: Three accounts running, 10+ videos/day total, $3,000+/month in net profit, your share clearing $750/month on top of base

Month 6: Established daily playbook, $15,000+/month in net profit, your share at $3,750/month on top of base (total ~$5,250/month)

Month 12: Scaled operation with 1–2 helpers you've trained, $25,000+/month net profit possible, your share clearing $6,000+/month plus base plus year-end bonus



Day-to-day responsibilities

You own day-to-day execution. That includes:



Product research — daily Kalodata / Shoplus / FastMoss workflow, your own filter stack, daily shortlist of 10 candidates, scoring top-performing videos for replicability



Sample sourcing — submit free sample requests and refundable sample purchases via TikTok Shop Creator Center to our US shipping addresses



Content production — generate 5 script variants per winning product, brief US-based on-camera recorders with structured shot lists, edit raw clips in CapCut



UGC creator hiring — you can brief and hire US-based on-camera talent through 
 (you brief them, they record, you edit and post — they don't need to keep the product). Budget for this comes out of operating expenses, approved by us.



Account operations — stagger-post 5–15 videos/day across 2–3 TikTok accounts (each on its own isolated device/IP), tag every video's affiliate product from Showcase before publishing, manage comment moderation and account hygiene



Pre-followed account acquisition — purchasing TikTok Shop-eligible accounts (5,000+ followers) is a legitimate part of the playbook. You'll source candidate accounts and submit them for our approval before purchase.



Drop-off & hook analytics — pull swipe-away / retention curves from TikTok analytics on every video, identify exactly where viewers leave, and use that data to rebuild hooks that hold attention past the first 3 seconds



Performance management — track 24-hour and 72-hour performance per video in shared Google Sheets, flag winners and losers per decision rules you build (with our sign-off)



Team training (when we hire) — when we approve a new hire, you train them, oversee their daily output, and earn a percentage of their net production on top of your base and your own profit share



Must-haves

1+ year hands-on TikTok Shop affiliate experience (you've personally operated accounts, not just managed someone else's)



Working knowledge of Kalodata, Shoplus, or FastMoss — you can name the filter stack you'd use to find a trending product without us prompting



Hook analytics fluency — you regularly look at where viewers swipe away from your videos and use that data to rebuild hooks. You can explain a specific time you fixed a low-retention video by studying the drop-off curve.



Exceptional written English (your scripts go to US viewers; your briefs go to US recorders)



Proven ability to ship volume — 5+ videos/day, every workday, without quality drop



Data-driven mindset — you read GMV growth, commission rate, and affiliate count signals fast and act on them



2+ years remote work experience with verifiable OnlineJobs.ph or Upwork references



Proficient in Slack, ClickUp or Notion, Google Sheets, CapCut, ChatGPT



4+ hour overlap with US Mountain Time



Reliable computer, fast internet, backup power



Comfortable with daily WhatsApp check-ins (morning plan + end-of-day recap) and a weekly direction call



Operator mindset — you treat this like real work that compounds, not a 9-to-5



Nice-to-haves

Prior experience under a US-LLC-backed structure operating US-market TikTok Shop accounts

Experience editing UGC-style product review videos

Experience hiring and briefing UGC creators (HourlyUGC, Upwork, Billo, etc.)

Experience buying and warming pre-followed TikTok accounts safely

Hands-on with Claude Code for scripting and automation tasks

Familiarity with US residential proxy / remote-desktop tooling (AnyDesk, RustDesk, BrightData)

Experience running multiple isolated social accounts without crossing fingerprints

Prior experience training and overseeing junior tea
mbers



Resources we provide

US LLC, EIN, US bank account, US shipping addresses, TikTok Shop seller verification

Working capital for samples, account purchases, and initial creator briefs

Tools budget: Kalodata, Shoplus or FastMoss, ChatGPT Plus, Claude Code, CapCut Pro, any other tool you make a case for

US-based UGC talent budget via HourlyUGC and similar platforms

Daily strategy access to the owner via WhatsApp, weekly direction call





Compensation

Base salary: $1,500/month ($8.66/hr × 40 hrs/week), paid weekly via Wise — your guaranteed floor



Personal profit share: 25% of monthly Net Profit you personally generate, paid monthly, uncapped, for as long as you are with the company



Net Profit definition: Gross affiliate commission revenue minus all operating costs, including your $1,500/month base salary, contractor pay (UGC creators, helpers), software subscriptions (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code, etc.), sample purchases, account purchases, banking fees, and US LLC overhead. Your base is paid by the company as a normal expense — it does NOT come out of your 25% share.



Worked example (a $5,000 Net Profit month):



Gross affiliate commission revenue: $8,000

Less your base salary: ?$1,500

Less samples & account purchases: ?$500

Less software (Kalodata, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude Code): ?$300

Less UGC creator contractor pay: ?$500

Less banking and LLC overhead: ?$200

= Net Profit: $5,000



Your 25% share: $1,250

Your total monthly comp: $1,500 base + $1,250 share = $2,750

Comp at higher Net Profit tiers (base always paid separately on top):

At $5,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $1,250 share = $2,750/month total



At $15,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $3,750 share = $5,250/month total



At $30,000/month Net Profit: $1,500 base + $7,500 share = $9,000/month total



Team override (when we hire helpers under you): When the company hires a helper under your direction, the helper's net production is split three ways:



Helper: 25% of their own net production (same share structure as yours)



You (operator override): 15% of the helper's net production, paid monthly alongside your personal profit share



Company: the remaining 60%



The 15% override equals 20% of the company's 75% cut — a meaningful piece of every helper you train and retain. The better you train them and the longer they stay productive, the larger your monthly override grows. Worked example: if a helper generates $5,000/month in net production, helper earns $1,250, you earn an additional $750 override on top of your own profit share, company keeps $3,000.



Year-end bonus: At fiscal year-end (December 31), you receive a bonus equal to 10% of the personal net profit you generated for the company during that fiscal year, paid by January 31.



Example: if your personal accounts generated $120,000 in net profit across the calendar year, your year-end bonus = $12,000, on top of all monthly profit shares already paid



This is designed to reward staying through the full year — someone who's accrued meaningful YTD profit has a real reason to finish the year strong rather than walk in November



Bonus applies only if you're with the company on December 31 of that year



Performance floor: After the first 3 months (during which we are getting the process / pipeline up and running): 

Your personal monthly net profit generation must clear your monthly base pay ($1,500). If you fall below base for 3 consecutive months OR any 4 months within a rolling 6-month window, the role is terminated unless we judge that exceptional extenuating circumstances apply (which we will weigh case by case).



Why this beats every comparable listing:

Typical TikTok Shop VA on OnlineJobs.ph: $800–1,500/month flat, no profit share, no bonus

Senior pod operator with commission: $1,500–2,000/month + 5% personal sales (~$1,750/month at our target revenue)

Most "profit share" listings: $2,000 base + 10?ove a high margin threshold (~$2,250/month at our target revenue)

This role at $15K/month personal net profit: $5,250/month + 15% override on any helpers you train (~$750/mo per $5K-producing helper) + year-end bonus accruing toward $12K+ — total annualized comp ceiling far above any flat-rate or pod role on this platform



Transparency: Net Profit is calculated from a Google Sheet you'll have read access to, updated daily. Every line item is visible. No black box.



How we work together

Daily WhatsApp check-ins. Each morning you send a short message with your plan for the day. Each evening you send a recap of what you completed. Takes 5 minutes total. This is non-negotiable.



Weekly direction call. One scheduled call per week (30–45 min) to discuss overall progress, priorities, and any decisions that need our sign-off.



Final decisions rest with us — all hiring, firing, base pay, account purchases, and revenue policy decisions default to the owner. You propose, recommend, build the case. We approve.



You have real autonomy inside that framework on day-to-day execution: content choices, hook iterations, posting cadence, niche pivots, product picks, contractor briefs.



Long-term mindset — the owner's other business has retained OnlineJobs.ph hires for 2+ years. We invest in operators who invest in us.



How to apply

Follow all application instructions below carefully.



In your application message, answer every question below, numbered, in order:



List every TikTok Shop affiliate account you've personally operated. Include handle and approximate monthly revenue at peak.



What product research tool do you use? Walk us through your exact filter stack — the specific filters, in order, that you'd apply right now to find a trending product worth promoting this week.



Describe one specific time you looked at a TikTok video's swipe-away curve, identified where viewers were dropping off, and rebuilt the hook to fix it. What did the original hook say, what did the data show, and what did you change it to?



Pick one TikTok Shop product you'd promote this week. Tell us (a) the product, (b) why you'd promote it (data-backed), and (c) the exact 3-second hook you'd open with.



Describe one independent operational decision you've made on a TikTok Shop account — what was the call, what was the data behind it, what was the outcome?



What's your current US Mountain Time overlap availability?



What tools are you currently paying for out of your own pocket?



Do you currently operate any personal TikTok Shop accounts? (Yes/No — full disclosure required if yes)





At the very end of your application, in the final line, type the word "Kalodata" so we know you read this entire post.



For applicants who do follow these instructions, we'll shortlist the strongest candidates for a paid 2-hour trial task ($16 paid via Wise), and then interview finalists directly with the owner.



We're hiring one person and we'd rather wait three weeks for the right one than three days for the wrong one.



If you've ever wanted to run a US-market TikTok Shop business with the LLC, banking, and infrastructure handled — this is your shot.

title: Remote Sales Closer (Via Zoom)
description:
SALES ENROLMENT CONSULTANT — BUSINESS ACCELERATOR

Driven Personal Trainers | Remote | 12 hrs/week to start | Immediate Start



---



About the Role



Driven Personal Trainers is an Australian PT placement and mentoring company with 100+ gym locations nationwide. We are growing fast and looking for a confident, results-driven Sales Enrolment Consultant to handle inbound discovery calls for our Business Accelerator Program.



The Business Accelerator is a 12-week founder-led coaching program for ambitious personal trainers who want to build a real, scalable PT business. Leads are generated and pre-qualified by our VA team — your job is to get on the call, understand the PT's situation, and close the enrolment.



This is a warm inbound role. You are not cold calling. Every person you speak to has already expressed interest and been pre-qualified before they hit your calendar.



---



What You Will Do



- Take 30-minute inbound discovery calls with pre-qualified personal trainers across Australia

- Review the pre-call questionnaire responses before each call so you are fully prepared

- Diagnose the PT's current situation, identify their pain points, and present the Business Accelerator as the solution

- Handle objections confidently and close enrolments on the call wherever possible

- Follow up with any undecided prospects within 24 hours using an approved follow-up sequence

- Log every call outcome in GoHighLevel (GHL) immediately after each call

- Send a daily summary to the founder covering calls taken, enrolments closed, and pipeline status

- Manage enrolled PTs during the 4-week pre-start window — welcome message, check-in, and start date confirmation



---



What We Are Looking For



- Proven experience in sales calls, closing, or phone-based consultation — this is non-negotiable

- Confident, warm, and natural communicator — you do not sound like you are reading a script

- Strong active listening skills — you ask great questions and use the PT's own words back to them

- Comfortable handling objections around price, timing, and uncertainty without being pushy

- Reliable and self-managed — you take calls, log outcomes, and follow up without being chased

- Familiarity with CRM tools — GoHighLevel experience is a bonus but not required

- Interest in the fitness or personal training industry is a plus but not essential



---



Role Details

title: Social Media Engagement Specialist — Pet Lifestyle Brands ($550–$650/mo)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

We're a small, fast-moving house of pet lifestyle brands — elevated, editorial accounts for cat and dog lovers, plus a creator course launching this fall. We treat our pets as family, and we talk up to our audience, never down. We're looking for one warm, sharp, genuinely likable person to be the daily voice of our brands in the comments and DMs.

This is an engagement role, not a posting role. Our team creates and schedules all the content. Your job is what happens after a post goes live — and in 2026, that's the single biggest driver of growth: fast, real, human engagement in the first hour.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY

Warm up the accounts before each post. In the ~15 minutes before our Reels go live, prime each account — reply to recent comments and leave a few genuine comments on accounts in our niche — so each post drops into an already-active feed. This pre-post warm-up is part of the daily rhythm, not optional.

Work the live window. The 
nt our Reels go live, you're there — replying to every comment and like, and starting real conversations across our Instagram and
 accounts. The first 60–90 minutes after each post is the priority.

Manage DMs across all accounts — answer questions, welcome new followers, route anything important to the manager.

Outbound engagement — genuinely engage in pet-focused communities and on creator accounts in our niche (thoughtful comments, not spam) to grow our presence.

Keep our voice — every reply sounds like the brand: warm, a little elevated, pets-as-family. We'll give you brand-voice tools that make this fast and consistent (full training provided).

Log your work daily via a simple Google Form.



THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying)



Our posts go live in the evening US time, which is morning your time. The core, non-negotiable window is:

7:45 AM – 10:30 AM Philippine time, 6 days a week — be online by ~7:45 AM to warm up the accounts before the first post. This is when content goes live, and engagement matters most.

Plus a short follow-up window later in your morning, and flexible hours for outbound, DMs, and planning.

If you can't reliably be online and engaging during that 7:45–10:30 AM PHT window six days a week, this role isn't the right fit — and that's okay.



HOW YOU'LL WORK



You'll work through Parsec on a company computer based in the US (we set this up and give you access). All engagement happens through that machine — never from your own phone or device. This protects our accounts and is strictly required.

You'll use our internal brand-voice reply tools to stay fast and on-brand. We do not allow outside AI content generators, and we screen applications for AI-written responses — please write to us in your own words.



You report to our Operations Manager — all day-to-day questions go to her.



PAY & LOGISTICS

$550–$650/month, paid biweekly via PayPal or Remitly (your choice). Invoices on the 15th and 1st, paid within two business days. Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid trial task before the final hire.



SCREENING QUESTIONS



Our posts go live in the US evening — that's 8:00–10:30 AM your time (PHT). Can you reliably be online and actively engaging during that window, six days a week? Please answer honestly.



Tell me about a brand or creator whose comment section/community engagement you admire — and what specifically makes it work.



In your own words: what's the difference between replying to comments and actually growing a community?



Quick voice sample — reply to this comment the way a warm, slightly-elevated pet brand would: "omg he is SO handsome, what breed is he??"



Are you comfortable working entirely inside our systems (Parsec on our US computer + our reply tools) and never engaging from your own device?

title: Content Editor & WordPress Publisher
description:
For this job, exceptional reading comprehension is the most important. You can spot awkward wording, contradictions, redundancies, missing context, and sentences that don't sound natural.

The web development and other skills can be taught and I have plenty of tutorials. But someone who speaks, reads and writes English well is very important. I don’t mean someone who uses Chat GPT to write everything. You will be reviewing content organized by AI so you can’t expect AI to fix it. You can use AI to assist you but if you’re not a good writer or reader yourself than Chat GPT won’t save you.

Your skills will increase over time and so will the work amount, quality and complexity. I will help you teach you what you need but you also need to put effort on your end to learn new things and always consult with AI using the resources I give you to see if there’s something you missed. 

SEO Content Editor (Remote, Full-Time)

I'm looking for a full-time SEO Content Editor to edit and publish AI-assisted articles for multiple clients across industries like legal, medical, engineering, and real estate.

The articles are already written. Your job is to read them, catch anything that feels off — an abrupt sentence, a word that doesn't fit, a paragraph that loses the reader — and fix it. Sometimes that's one word. Sometimes it's a sentence or two. Then you'll add internal and external links, find or generate images, and publish everything in WordPress. A typical article takes 10 to 45 minutes depending on length and complexity.

What You'll Be Doing

Read articles and make small but precise edits for flow, tone, and readability

Add internal links to relevant pages on the same site and external links to credible third-party sources

Source or generate images, optimize them for web, and add alt text and captions

Publish in WordPress with the correct title tag, meta description, author, and category

Submit URLs to Google Search Console and Bing for indexing

Requirements

Excellent reading comprehension and written English

Strong attention to detail

Comfortable with WordPress and AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini

Reliable, responsive, and able to work 10am–6pm MDT independently

Assessment

Read the following two sentences and spot the one redundancy with the second one and how you'd fix it.

Question 1:

Myocardial infarction, commonly known as a heart attack, occurs when blood flow to part of the heart is blocked. This blockage, which can be caused by a buildup of plaque in the arteries, is something that can result in serious damage to the heart muscle tissue if it is not treated promptly and in a timely manner.

Question 2:

 What's awkward about this paragraph?

The witness reviewed the report. The report was reviewed by the witness before the witness submitted the report.

Question 3:

Which sentence sounds more natural?

A:

The company provides electrical services for residential homes.

B:

The company provides residential electrical services.

You should record yourself doing these assessments with Loom, have the camera turned on and talk through the edits you’re making. Fluent English is a requirement.



Put strawberry in the subject line and use 2 AP to apply (no more no less). For your ideal rate, also put $8/hr. This is the starting salary with a $1 per year raise depending on performance. If you put more or less for the desired salary you won't be considered.



Free Homepage Design — Web Production Assistant

What you'll do:

You'll use a pre-built HTML template and AI tools to create custom homepage demos for leads and prospective clients. Each demo takes about 30–45 minutes once you're comfortable with the process.

Step-by-step process:

Receive a client lead with basic info (name, company, transcript, or CV)

Paste the client info and the template HTML into Claude — ask it to return the full updated HTML

Generate a logo using ChatGPT (if the client doesn't have one)

Find or generate all images (hero, services, FAQ, organization logos, expert photo) using ChatGPT or Unsplash

Replace the placeholder image files in the project folder with client-specific images (save files with the correct filenames so they auto-update)

Remove any background from the expert/person photo using Photoshop or Canva

Proofread the page — check for wrong pronouns, leftover text from other clients, or broken images

Do a quality assurance check using the Ask Gemini feature in Chrome

Take a full-page screenshot using the Awesome Screenshot Chrome extension

Save the screenshot as [ClientName]-[Company]-[Expertise]-website-demo and send it over

Tools you'll use:

VS Code (to view/edit the HTML file)

Claude (to generate updated HTML content)

ChatGPT (to generate images and logos)

Unsplash (for stock photography)

Photoshop or Canva (to remove image backgrounds)

Google Chrome + Awesome Screenshot extension (for the final screenshot)

What to watch for:

Wrong pronouns (especially when the AI assumes gender from a name)

Broken or missing images

Text left over from a previous client's demo

No coding experience required — the process is mostly file management, AI prompting, and attention to detail.

Assessments

You need the full html but Claude only returned the text content. What do you prompt to get the full HTML? (Shouldn’t be more than 7 words.)

You download an image from Unsplash which is a jpg but you need a png. What do you do? Hint: you can change the extension simply by updating the name. (this one requires a quick Loom video. It should take 5 seconds)





WordPress Website Tasks

I'll train you on everything you need to know, and I provide tutorial videos walking through each task step by step. Your job is to watch those videos carefully and execute the process accurately. If you can follow a process and pay attention to detail, you'll do great here.

What you'll be doing:

Updating client websites using my custom WordPress theme hosted on Cloudways

Swapping out images, text, and page content based on the video walkthroughs I provide

Following a repeatable process for each client deliverable

Taking full page screenshots and sending completed work to me for review

Doing a quality assurance check on each page to catch things like wrong pronouns, broken images, or leftover text from a previous client

What I'm looking for:

Basic familiarity with WordPress (you understand the dashboard, how pages and posts work)

Someone who can watch a tutorial video and replicate the steps without needing hand-holding

Strong attention to detail

Reliable, communicates clearly, and asks questions when stuck rather than guessing

Nice to have:

Experience with Cloudways or any managed WordPress hosting

Familiarity with image editing tools like Canva or Photoshop

You can't have another job while working here. This has to be your full-time job and you have to be very responsive throughout the day through Google Chat. Not listening to the notification is not an excuse.

Ability to follow directions and implement feedback

title: Video Editor
description:
# Hiring: YouTube Walking Tour Video Editor (4K Travel & Ambient Content)



## About the Channel



I am launching a premium YouTube channel called **Scape Walk 4K**, focused on immersive 4K walking tours from around the world.



The channel features:



* Cinematic walking tours

* Travel and city exploration

* Ambient natural sound

* No talking or vlogging

* Relaxing, immersive experiences

* 4K UHD content



Editing style should be similar to:



* POPtravel

* Nomadic Ambience

* Watched Walker

* 4K Urban Life



Reference Video:





---



# What You'll Be Editing



Raw footage filmed on:



* GoPro 4K

* City walks

* Parks

* Beaches

* Tourist attractions

* Nightlife districts

* Hidden local neighborhoods



Typical video length:



* 30–90 minutes



---



# Responsibilities



## Video Editing



* Remove unusable footage

* Remove unnecessary stops and interruptions

* Improve pacing while maintaining immersion

* Maintain a natural walking experience

* Deliver smooth, professional edits



## Color Grading



* Create a cinematic travel look

* Improve dynamic range

* Enhance colors naturally

* Improve nighttime footage

* Maintain realistic color representation



## Audio Enhancement



* Clean ambient audio

* Reduce wind noise

* Preserve natural environmental sounds

* Create immersive listening experiences



## YouTube Optimization



* Build strong opening sequences

* Improve audience retention

* Optimize export settings for YouTube 4K



## Thumbnail Creation (Bonus)



* Create compelling travel thumbnails

* Understand YouTube CTR principles

* Select strong 
nts from footage



---



# Required Skills



You should have experience editing:



* Walking tours

* Travel videos

* Ambient content

* Nature videos

* Cinematic city footage



Software:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro



Must understand:



* 4K workflows

* Audio cleanup

* Color grading

* Viewer retention

* Travel YouTube content



---



# What Makes an Ideal Candidate



The ideal editor understands that successful walking tour videos are not simply stitched-together footage.



The goal is to make viewers feel like they are physically present in the location.



You understand:



* Atmosphere

* Immersion

* Pacing

* Sound design

* Visual storytelling without narration



You know how to create content that keeps viewers watching for 15, 20, or even 30+ minutes.



---



# Application Requirements



Please include:



1. Your portfolio

2. Links to travel or walking tour videos you edited

3. Your editing software

4. Your rate per video

5. Typical turnaround time









---



# Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be given a paid test project.



You will receive approximately 5–10 minutes of raw footage and be asked to create a polished final edit.



The purpose is to evaluate:



* Editing judgment

* Audio quality

* Color grading

* Pacing

* Attention to detail



The test is paid.



---



# How Applications Will Be Evaluated



Candidates will be scored on:



### 30% – Travel / Walking Tour Experience



Show examples of similar work.



### 25% – Audio Quality



Ability to create immersive environmental sound.



### 20% – Color Grading



Ability to produce a cinematic but realistic image.



### 15% – Viewer Retention Understanding



Ability to identify and remove boring sections while preserving immersion.



### 10% – Communication & Reliability



Responsiveness, professionalism, and ability to meet deadlines.



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This is not a one-time project.



The goal is to build a long-term relationship with an editor who can help grow Scape Walk 4K into a leading travel and walking-tour brand.



Expected production:



* 2–4 videos per week

* Consistent ongoing work

* Opportunity for increased responsibilities as the channel grows



---



# Important



Many editors can cut footage.



Very few editors understand how to create an immersive experience that makes viewers feel like they are walking through the city themselves.



If you have that skill, I would love to work with you.

title: Marketing & Social Media Manager
description:
Position Overview

Are you a master storyteller who knows how to capture the emotion of a major milestone and turn it into high-converting digital content?



Get House Ready LLC is looking for a dynamic, versatile, and highly confident Marketing & Social Media Manager. We are not your average real estate team. We are a powerhouse, dual-licensed ecosystem that seamlessly integrates Residential Real Estate Sales, Mortgage Loan Origination, and automated Credit Score Improvement into a single client journey.



We don't just sell houses—we build bridges for families transitioning from "Not Yet Ready" to "Clear to Close." Your mission will be to deeply understand the vision of the CEO, translate that vision across all marketing channels, and capture our daily "wins" to tell the inspiring story of our clients and our brand.



Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Management & Brand Storytelling

The "Win" Engine: Actively extract, curate, and post our daily operational triumphs (e.g., credit score jumps, loan pre-approvals, under-contract milestones, clear-to-close notices, and key handovers) to attract an organic audience of homebuyers and professional partners.



Content Creation: Script, film, and edit high-quality, high-engagement short-form video content (TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and long-form educational pieces.



CEO Vision Translation: Work closely with the CEO to absorb her strategic concepts, unique marketing voice, and industry insights, successfully transforming them into authentic, polished public content.



2. Multi-Channel Marketing & CRM Automation

GoHighLevel (GHL) Architecture: Manage, optimize, and build out marketing funnels, automated text/email workflows, and nurture sequences within our GHL ecosystem (The Engine Room).



 Marketing: Write, design, and deploy highly engaging weekly newsletters and targeted broadcast campaigns to our database of buyers, realtors, and professional networks.



Omnichannel Strategy: Ensure seamless brand consistency across all touchpoints, including
 Groups, LinkedIn Premium Company pages, TikTok, YouTube,
 blasts, and local community outreach.



3. Leadership, Innovation, & Execution

Confident Strategy: We don't want a passive order-taker. You must be confident to bring bold, innovative marketing suggestions to the table, defend your strategies with data, and immediately execute them.



Team Collaboration & Independence: Work hand-in-hand with our internal loan processing teams, realtors, and credit advocates to pull content assets while operating with complete independence day-to-day.



Required Skills & Experience

Proven Experience: 3+ years of experience in Social Media Management, Digital Marketing, or Content Creation (Experience in Real Estate, Mortgage, or Credit Restoration is a massive plus).



Technical Mastery: Hands-on proficiency with GoHighLevel (GHL) or a highly comparable enterprise CRM system (including workflow triggers, funnel builders, and
 marketing suites).



Multimedia Production: Strong video editing skills (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or Canva) with a sharp eye for modern aesthetic trends, micro-hooks, and scannable visual typography.



Advanced Communication: Exceptional copywriting, scriptwriting, and editing skills. You must be able to write complex financial transformations in a simple, punchy, and emotionally resonant way.



Leadership & Feedback Dynamics: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to take direction gracefully from executive leadership, absorb constructive feedback, and proactively lead collaborative team initiatives.



Why Join Get House Ready LLC?

We are a fast-growing, tech-forward, and highly collaborative team driven by automation and life-changing client results. If you are a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves celebrating human victories, and wants the creative autonomy to execute big ideas, we want to talk to you.

title: Credit Solutions Closer / Enrollment Specialist
description:
Position Overview

Are you a high-energy closer who thrives on helping people overcome obstacles and achieve the American Dream?



Get House Ready LLC is looking for a fierce, empathetic, and highly driven Credit Solutions Closer. We are an elite, tech-forward ecosystem that combines real estate, mortgage lending, and advanced credit score improvement to turn "not-yet-ready" renters into qualified, confident homebuyers.



Our marketing engine and loan origination teams do the heavy lifting of identifying exactly what our buyers need. Your sole mission is to close the deal. You will take qualified, high-intent hot leads, present our tailored credit restoration products and automated action plans, overcome final objections, and officially enroll them into our programs.



Key Responsibilities

High-Volume Closing: Execute structured enrollment consultations with warm, pre-vetted leads who have already been identified as needing credit score improvement to buy a home.



Product Matching & Value Presentation: Expertly present our suite of credit score improvement tools, automated legal dispute strategies, and reporting products (including Rental Kharma and Experian Boost frameworks) tailored to the client's specific report analysis.



Objection Handling & Financial Mapping: Confidently navigate objections regarding pricing, timelines, and past financial trauma. You must connect the cost of our credit products to the massive long-term savings of a lower mortgage payment.



Seamless Onboarding: Secure the contract signature, process enrollment payments, and smoothly transition the new client over to their dedicated Credit Advocate to begin their journey.



CRM Pipeline Discipline: Maintain flawless, real-time data tracking within our GoHighLevel CRM platform, ensuring daily follow-ups are executed systematically.



Required Skills & Experience

Proven Sales Track Record: 2+ years of high-closing sales experience, specifically within Credit Repair Sales, Debt Settlement, Alternative Financial Services, or Mortgage/Real Estate inside sales.



Credit Industry Fluency: Deep, fundamental understanding of credit bureaus, FICO scoring models, collections, charge-offs, utilization ratios, and consumer credit laws. You must be able to talk intelligently about credit reports from day one.



Elite Closing Skills: Master of the one-call close. You know how to create urgency, uncover the buyer's true "why," and ask for the money confidently while maintaining absolute empathy for their situation.



Ecosystem Mindset: Ability to align with the company's broader vision—understanding that closing a credit file today unlocks a massive mortgage commission and real estate sale for the team tomorrow.



Autonomy & Grit: Highly disciplined self-starter who loves the phone, welcomes constructive feedback from leadership, and is motivated by a high-upside performance structure.



Why Join Get House Ready LLC?

We don't do cold calling. Our clients want to buy a home, and you are providing the exact key that unlocks their approval. We offer an aggressive, performance-driven compensation plan where your closing skills directly dictate your income.

Because we are active investors ourselves, we operate with a unique edge: we treat every single property we manage with the exact same care and strategic oversight as our own assets. *English (Fluent)

, and social channels

title: Billing Specialist
description:
It has to make sense. That is the standard at Divorce With A Plan. Not "close enough." Not "that is just how billing works." It has to make sense to the client, or we have not done our job.



Clients are high-net-worth professionals going through divorce across the state of Maryland. They are intelligent, capable people navigating a financial experience they were never trained for. They do not know what an evergreen retainer is. They do not know what a trust replenishment request means or why it matters. And if no one explains it in a way that makes sense to them, they lose confidence in the process, and they lose sight of the plan they are working toward.



That is the problem this role solves.



The Billing Specialist at Divorce With A Plan is the person who makes the financial side of a divorce case make sense to the client. You walk beside them from the day they retain the firm through the day the case closes, connecting every payment to the outcome they are working toward. You are part of their walk. You are the one who helps them see that the $5,000 retainer replenishment is not just a number. It is the next step toward the custody arrangement they need, the property division that protects their future, the agreement that lets them move forward.



The time you spend with clients explaining their billing, answering their questions, and making sure their plan still makes sense to them is not an extra. It is not a favor. It is part of the service. There is no additional cost to the client for the time you invest in making sure they understand. That is how this firm works, and it is one of the reasons clients trust us.



How we do it: the right way.



This firm runs on structure. There is a defined process for everything, because when the process is clear, the client gets a consistent experience no matter which attorney is on their case or which week of the month it is. You will have a daily call block schedule so clients are never waiting days for a return call. You will have a billing script built on the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct so clients hear accurate, compliant information every time. You will have an escalation protocol with documented timestamps, so no client concern sits unaddressed. You will have a weekly deliverable that captures how clients are feeling, what they need, and what feedback they are giving us, so the firm can respond to what clients are actually experiencing, not what we assume they are experiencing.



If you are someone who finds relief in knowing exactly what the standard is, exactly what a good day looks like, and exactly what is expected, keep reading.



What you produce: a contribution that protects the client and the firm.



The Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct require that clients be kept informed about the status of their matter (Rule 1.4), that fees are reasonable and clearly communicated (Rule 1.5), and that client funds held in trust are safeguarded with precision (Rule 1.15). Those rules exist to protect the client. Everything this role does is built around upholding them.



Every call you make either keeps a client informed or it does not. Every replenishment conversation either connects the payment to the client's goals and gives them the information they are entitled to, or it leaves them making financial decisions without the full picture. Every trust balance you monitor either gets flagged the same day it drops below threshold, protecting the client's funds and the firm's fiduciary obligation, or it becomes the kind of gap that puts both at risk.



You are not here to process invoices. You are here to contribute to something that matters: a client's ability to get through the hardest financial experience of their life with clarity, dignity, and a plan that makes sense to them, while ensuring the fir
ets the professional standards that make all of that possible. Here is who thrives in this role.



You genuinely like people. Not in theory. In practice. You are energized by 20+ phone conversations a day because you actually want to know how someone is doing, and they can tell the difference. You remember that a client's daughter just started high school, that another client lost their job two months ago, that someone told you in March they were scared about the mediation in May, and when you call in May, you ask about it before you ask about the balance.







You are organized because you cannot function without a system. You manage 100 to 150 active client relationships, and nothing falls through because you built something (a spreadsheet, a calendar, a color-coded tracker, a handwritten list) that keeps you moving. You do not wait for someone to tell you what needs attention. You see the attorney's calendar, you see the hearing in two weeks, and you pick up the phone, because the client deserves to know what is coming before it arrives.



You have the emotional range to sit with a client who is crying about their financial situation on Tuesday and have a firm, direct conversation about a past-due balance on Wednesday, and both conversations are authentic because both come from the same place: you care about this person's outcome, and you are going to tell them the truth.



You have been described as "the person who can get anyone to pay," and you know the reason is not pressure. It is trust. People pay you because you took the time to help them understand what they were paying for and why it mattered to their case.



Here is who this role is not for.

1. If you want to process invoices in a back office and never talk to a client, this role will make you miserable.

2. If you avoid difficult conversations about money, you will not survive the first month. These clients are going through a divorce. Money is emotional. You need to be able to hold that space and still move the conversation forward, because the client needs someone who will stay in it with them.

3. If you need someone to tell you what to do every hour, this is not the right structure for you. You will have clear expectations, daily blocks, and weekly deliverables. Within that framework, you think, prioritize, and act. Problems get fixed or flagged, because a problem that sits is a client who waits.



If you read from a script without understanding why each line exists, you will fail here. Every call requires context. You know what is happening in the client's case before you dial, and you lead with that, because a client who feels known is a client who stays engaged in their own plan.



If the phrase "it has to make sense" does not resonate with you at a gut level, if you are comfortable with "good enough" or "that is just how we do it," you will not be happy working here.



Responsibilities

1. Make the Financial Side of the Case Make Sense from Day One

2. Within five business days of retention, deliver a billing tutorial covering retainer structure, evergreen replenishment, invoice format, and what to expect at each stage, so the client starts their case understanding how the financial side works before they receive their first invoice.

3. Conduct a live introductory call to walk through the material, answer questions, and establish the relationship. This call gives the client a person they can reach when billing feels confusing, and it gives you the context to serve them well for the life of their case.

4. Provide specific dollar ranges for upcoming cost events (hearings: $5,000-$10,000, mediations, trials: $15,000-$30,000) so the client can plan ahead instead of reacting to surprises.

5. Introduce yourself as a non-billable point of contact. The time you spend making sure their plan still makes sense to them is part of the service, not an add-on. Clients who know they can call you without a meter running are clients who stay informed and engaged.

6. Keep Trust Accounts Funded by Keeping Clients Informed

7. Monitor trust balances daily across
active matters so no client's case is disrupted by a funding gap they did not see coming.

8. Call every client before sending a replenishment request. No
 goes out without a phone call attempt. The call comes first because the client deserves a conversation, not a demand.

9. When requesting additional retainers for upcoming events, reference the specific event by name and the date you first discussed it. This tells the client you are paying attention to their case, not just their balance.

10. Flag any matter below the trust threshold the same day. Not at the next billing cycle. The same day. A delay means the client's case could stall without warning.

11. Process Invoices the Right Way

12. Prepare, review, and distribute client invoices on a biweekly cycle, so clients receive accurate, consistent billing they can follow.

13. Review every time entry on every invoice for accuracy, specificity, and consistency. Flag entries that are vague, duplicative, or do not reflect the actual work performed, because a confusing invoice erodes the client's trust in the firm.

15. Contact timekeepers directly to resolve questionable entries before pre-bills go to attorneys. The client should never have to question whether an entry is real.

17. Distribute finalized invoices on the scheduled date with payment links included so clients always know what they owe and how to pay without chasing anyone down.

18. Collect by Connecting Payment to Progress

19. Maintain accounts receivable below 2% of total billings.

20. Execute 12-15 outbound calls per day during the morning AR block, with every call documented in Clio so the client's history is always current if another tea
mber needs to step in.

21. Lead every collections conversation with a case update: what was accomplished, what is upcoming, and how the work connects to the client's goal. The client hears the value before they hear the number.

22. When a client says they cannot pay, walk through every option: credit cards, personal loans, family support, employer assistance, and legal fee financing. You do not accept "I cannot" without helping them look at every door first, because a client who feels they have no options may abandon a case they still need.

23. Send payment links the same day after any commitment so the client can act while the conversation is fresh.

24. Listen, Learn, and Report What Clients Need

Pay attention to what clients tell you on every call. Their questions, their frustrations, their confusion, and their feedback are data the firm needs to hear so we can serve them better.

25. Produce a weekly deliverable every Friday, capturing client feedback, recurring questions, unresolved needs, and what you are hearing about the client experience. This is how the firm stays connected to what clients actually need instead of guessing.

26. When a billing concern arises, log it with a documented timestamp and route it to the responsible attorney via
 so the client gets a response, not silence.

27. Escalate any concern involving bar grievance, fraud, or legal action language to firm leadership the same day, because those situations require immediate attention to protect the client and the firm.

28. Stay Ahead of the Attorneys

Check attorney calendars for upcoming hearings, mediations, and trials. Initiate additional retainer requests before anyone asks, so the client has time to prepare instead of scrambling.

29. Confirm all credits, write-offs, and billing holds in writing before any related bill is finalized. If a credit is pending and you are not certain it has been applied, hold the bill. A client should never receive an invoice that does not reflect what the firm already knows.

30. Document every retainer reduction, billing pause, or special instruction in Clio at the matter level the same day so the next person who touches the file has the full picture and the client never has to repeat themselves.



Qualifications

Required:

 • 2+ years in billing, collections, or accounts receivable in a professional services environment. Law firm experience strongly preferred.

 • High comfort with outbound phone calls and client-facing conversations. This role requires 20+ calls per day. If phones drain you, this is not the right fit.

 • Proficiency with practice management software (Clio Manage preferred, or ability to learn within 30 days).

 • Ability to read and interpret legal invoices, time entries, trust account statements, and engagement agreements.

 • Strong written communication for documented escalations, client correspondence, and weekly deliverables.

 • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Calendar, Drive).

 • Demonstrated ability to manage 100+ active relationships simultaneously without dropping threads.



Preferred

 • Experience in a family law firm or litigation practice.

 • Familiarity with the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct as they relate to billing. Training provided, but baseline awareness accelerates onboarding.

 • Experience with evergreen retainer models and trust accounting.

 • Prior use of LawPay, Dialpad, or Clio Grow.

 • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.



About Divorce with a Plan

Benefits / Why Work Here

 • Fully remote. We serve clients across the entire state of Maryland. You work from wherever you work best.

 • A firm that builds systems so clients get a consistent experience. You will have scripts, checklists, escalation protocols, a daily structure, and technology supporting you from day one.

 • Direct impact you can measure. Your collections rate, your AR percentage, the client feedback you surface: you will see exactly how your work makes a difference for real people going through real situations.

 • Training on the Maryland Rules of Professional Conduct as they apply to billing. This gives you compliance knowledge that transfers to any law firm career and ensures every client interaction meets the standard.



How to Apply

 • Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your legal billing experience, familiarity with trust accounting, and any experience with Clio or similar platforms. Bilingual candidates are encouraged to note their language proficiency.

 • As part of the application process, please also complete the initial interview using the link below:

 • Initial AI Interview Link:
