title: Part-Time Video Editor: Short-Form + Monthly Long-Form
description:
Job overview

I run a commentary and education brand publishing short videos on culture, philosophy, and current affairs across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X, plus one longer-form YouTube video each month. I shoot the footage; you turn it into finished, posted-ready edits.



I'm looking for one reliable editor to own the edit end-to-end: 3–5 short videos per week (90–180 seconds each) and one long-form video per month (20–45 minutes). This is a steady, ongoing relationship, not a one-off gig. I want someone I can hand raw footage to and get back a clean cut that follows a consistent style guide, week after week.





What you'll do

Cut 3–5 short videos per week (90–180s) for TikTok / Reels / Shorts / X, vertical 9:16

Edit one long-form video per month (8–20 min) for YouTube, horizontal 16:9

Add captions/subtitles to a fixed style spec (single-line, short, readable on mobile)

Apply a consistent colour grade and audio clean-up (Lumetri + speech enhancement)

Cut to pacing — remove dead air, tighten gaps, keep energy high in the first 3 seconds

Add simple B-roll, text overlays, zoom punch-ins, and light motion where it serves the point

Export to platform specs and deliver organised, named files on schedule

Take direction from written notes and a style guide, and apply feedback without repeating mistakes





Must-have requirements

Proven short-form editing for social (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) — hook-first, fast pacing

Strong Adobe Premiere Pro skills (this is non-negotiable)

Comfortable with talking-head / commentary edits cut from raw footage

Clean caption work: timing, readability, no typos

Colour grading and audio repair basics (Lumetri, denoise, speech enhance)

Reliable: hits deadlines, communicates proactively, available for consistent weekly turnaround

Working computer that runs Premiere smoothly + stable internet for large file transfer

Good written English for receiving notes and asking questions







How to apply — read carefully

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed. I'm filtering for people who read instructions.



Start your message with: PREMIERE-READY

In 3–4 sentences, tell me your experience editing short-form social video and long-form YouTube, and confirm you edit in Adobe Premiere Pro (not just CapCut).

Send links to three samples:

At least one short-form vertical video (TikTok/Reel/Short)

At least one long-form video (8+ min) cut from raw footage — tell me what was raw vs. what you added

One more of your choice

Tell me your weekly availability and your typical turnaround time for a 90-second short.

title: SEO Specialist (Local SEO + AI Search / GEO & AEO) — US Senior Care
description:
Golden Years Home Care is a family-owned senior in-home care company in California, celebrating our 30th year of helping families care for their aging loved ones. We provide premium, white-glove in-home care — including Alzheimer's, dementia, and 24-hour care — across multiple cities: Sacramento, Roseville, Elk Grove, Lincoln, and San Diego.

We are hiring a long-term SEO Specialist to own how Golden Years shows up online — in traditional Google search, local maps, AND in modern AI answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity. This is a stable, long-term role for someone who wants to grow with a compassionate and thriving company.

What You'll Do

1. Local SEO (Our #1 Priority)

Optimize Google Business Profiles (GBP) for all our locations (categories, services, posts, photos, Q&A).

Rank us in the local map pack and "near me" searches for terms like in-home care, dementia care, and senior caregiver in each city we serve.

Build and clean up local citations and directory listings; keep NAP (Name, Address, Phone) strictly consistent.

Help grow and manage our online reviews strategy.

2. Technical & On-Page SEO

Run site audits and fix indexing, site speed, mobile responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals issues (our site is on WordPress / Divi).

Implement advanced structured data / schema markup (LocalBusiness, FAQ, Service, Review).

Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headers, and internal linking structures.

Conduct keyword research, topic clustering, and search-intent mapping.

3. AI Search Visibility (GEO, AEO & LLMO)

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Optimize our content to get surfaced and cited inside AI search results.

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Structure content as clear, answer-first responses to win featured snippets, voice search, and AI direct answers.

LLMO: Improve how AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) reference and recommend Golden Years.

Build semantically rich, entity-based content that establishes our authority in senior and dementia care.

Track where and how we appear across AI search platforms.

4. Content Strategy & Reporting

Collaborate with our marketing team on SEO content (service pages, location pages, blogs).

Monitor rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and conversions.

Provide clear monthly reports highlighting what's working and outlining the next actionable steps.

Skills & Requirements

Experience: 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience with proven ranking/traffic results.

Local SEO Expertise: Strong multi-location experience (Google Business Profile, map pack, citations).

Modern SEO Mindset: Knowledge of GEO/AEO and a real, active interest in AI search optimization.

Tools: Proficient with Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), and SEMrush or Ahrefs.

Technical: Experience with Screaming Frog (or similar audit tools), WordPress (Divi is a plus), and basic HTML.

Communication: Excellent written English — you will be writing and optimizing content for a premium US audience.

Setup: Reliable computer + high-speed, stable internet connection.

Mindset: Self-directed, highly organized, and dependable for long-term work.

Nice to Have:

Experience working with US clients, healthcare, senior care, or local-services businesses.

Deep familiarity with advanced schema markup and AI citation tracking.

Experience with GoHighLevel.

Graphic design or basic Canva skills.

Why Join Us?

Stability: Long-term, stable, full-time role with a respected 30-year-old company.

Impact: Work on meaningful marketing — every lead you bring in helps a family get the care they need.

Culture: Friendly team and direct communication with the marketing manager.

Growth: Room to grow as we continue to expand our footprint across California.

How to Apply

?? Important: To show us you actually read this post and pay attention to details (and aren't sending a generic, copy-paste application), please follow these steps exactly:

Start your application message with the word "SUNRISE" at the very top. Applications without this word will be automatically filtered out.

Briefly tell us about one local SEO or AI-search win you are proud of — what you did, and what the concrete result was.

Attach your resume and any examples/screenshots of rankings or organic traffic growth you have driven.

(Optional but highly appreciated) Include a link to a short 1-minute video introducing yourself.

We review every application that follows these steps. We are excited to meet you!

Golden Years Home Care is an equal opportunity employer.

title: WixWebsite Cleanup and Fine Tune
description:
For the website:







Correct the following things:

1. Homepage structure

2. Flow Refinement

3. Call to Action (B.O.T. integration/Interactive A.I. B.O.T. implementation)[I have an avatar in mind for use here.

4. Call to action placements

5. Layout Spacing

6. Visual Hierarchy

7. Cleanup*[this refers to section A below]

8. Conversion Guidance (Call to action related)

9. Navigation Simplification

10. UX alignment



In addition to these things as well:

1. Performance & Technical Health and Mobile Friendliness

2. Content Quality & Credibility

3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) [considering the next task after this is the implementation 

of a TikTok Shop instead of a Shopify Store connection.      .

4. Analytics & Visitor Behavior (Can you determine these things without access to the site admin?)





Section A:

**Audit Summary**



I inspected [
](
), its shop pages, 

sitemap/robots files, rendered homepage structure, mobile layout behavior, and the visible A.I. 

chat widget. Short version: the brand/world is distinctive, but the site is currently carrying too 

much navigation, too many competing paths, weak mobile containment, uneven SEO structure, and 

unclear conversion priority. Those issues should be cleaned up before TikTok Shop integration, 

because TikTok traffic will be mostly mobile, fast-moving, and conversion-sensitive. [Creation of the TikTok store will be another gig/job]



**Highest Priority Findings**



1. **Mobile friendliness needs urgent refinement**

The homepage does not fit cleanly into a phone-width viewport. In a 390px mobile test, 

desktop-style navigation and CTA elements extended far off-screen, creating horizontal overflow. 

This is the biggest practical issue because TikTok Shop traffic will likely arrive from 

mobile/in-app browsing.



2. **Navigation is too deep**

The homepage exposed about **70 links/ 65 unique URLs**, including many character, universe, 

community, group, member, and forum. This needs to not be deleted but repurposed to not be this "deep", , but cleaner and then leading to the depth in a more smooth fashion.



shop, and dynamic pages. This weakens visitor decision-making. Recommended top-level nav: 

·Home'·,Universe','Books','Shop',

·Characters·, ·Community'·,Contact'. Everything else should sit under structured hub pages.



3. **Homepage hierarchy is confused**

The page has multiple'H1' elements: "ALL About The Author," "Enter The UnderShadow Universe," and 

duplicate "Enter The UnderShadow Agency Mall." The actual first-screen brand/title is marked as' 

H2', not 'H1•. This hurts accessibility, SEO clarity, and conversion flow. The homepage should have 

one primary'H1', likely "The UnderShadow Agency," with secondary sections beneath it.



4. **CTA flow is visually present but strategically unclear**

There are CTAs for Shop, About, Mall, subscription, contact, and A.I. chat, but the page does not 

make one primary next action obvious. For TikTok Shop readiness, the site should prioritize:

'Watch/Discover-> Shop featured item-> Join briefing list-> Ask C.O.S.M.O.S./B.O.T.' Right now 

those actions compete rather than guide.



5. **B.O.T./A.I. chat is present, but response reliability needs review**

The "Chat with Al" widget opened successfully and displayed a welcome response. I tested a simple 

query: "Where can I buy books or merch?" The message appeared in the chat, but I did not observe a 

follow-up A.I. answer during the test window. That should be retested inside the site/admin tooling 

because the front-end trigger works, but the response flow may need tuning.

6. **Performance risk is high**

The rendered homepage showed about **155 observed assets**, including roughly **100 scripts**, **21 

images**, **7 fonts**, **2 stylesheets**, and **1 video asset**. Wix handles some optimization 

automatically, including AVIF image delivery, but this is still heavy. Adding TikTok pixels, 

product embeds, automation scripts, or richer bot behavior without cleanup may worsen mobile load 

and responsiveness.



7. **Accessibility and image metadata need cleanup**

On the homepage, I found **26 images** with **10 missing alt attributes**. On the APEX merch page, 

**18 images** with **9 missing alt attributes**. This affects accessibility, SEO, and product 

discoverability.



8. **Shop/CRO readiness is incomplete**

The [Book Shop](
) page has a weak meta description: "Book Shop." 

The [APEX merch page] (
) has no visible heading structure 

detected and no meta description. Product listings are present, but the commerce path'i).eeds 

stronger product storytelling, trust cues, shipping/return clarity, reviews/social proof, and 

direct "Buy now" behavior.



9. **Product sitemap appears stale**

The [store product sitemap](
) lists 

products last modified in **2021**, while the page sitemap shows many pages updated around **May 

19, 2026**. Before TikTok Shop, product metadata should be refreshed: titles, descriptions, images, 

availability, pricing, canonical URLs, and structured product data where possible.



10. **SEO indexability is mostly open, but sitemap structure is noisy**

The [robots.txt](
) allows crawling and points to sitemaps. 

The [main sitemap](
. 
/sitemap.xml) includes many multilingual and 

dynamic sitemap entries. That is not inherently bad, but it increases the need for clean carionical 

strategy, correct page titles, and no thin/duplicate dynamic pages.



**Additional Categories To Add**



- **Accessibility/WCAG:** heading order, alt text, keyboard navigation, contrast, form labels, chat 

accessibility.

- **SEO governance:** page titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, duplicate "copy-of' URLs, 

product schema.

- **Commerce trust:** shipping, returns, delivery time, payment methods, product size/fit info, 

reviews.

- **TikTok Shop readiness:** mobile product landing pages, pixel/events, UTM tracking, product feed 

quality, creator/social proof.

- **Content architecture:** separate "world-building" from "buy/subscribe" paths so visitors are 

not asked to decode the universe before converting.

- **Automation QA:** verify chat scripts, form submissions, newsletter automations, abandoned cart, 

TikTok event firing, and CRM tagging from admin/testing tools.

Location: Remote | (U.S. Eastern Time availability preferred for live working sessions)

About 


 is a leading provider of business book summaries, delivering professional, high-quality insights in text and audio formats. We help professionals stay current and competitive by distilling the best ideas from today’s bestselling business books. 
 is a subsidiary of Soundview, Inc.



Position Summary


 is seeking a seasoned ClickUp Expert to help us design, implement, and optimize ClickUp as the central operating system for our content production, marketing, and editorial workflows. This is a focused, 3-week project-based engagement with a fixed price paid out in milestones. The goal: set up scalable best practices, custom workflows, automations, dashboards, and team adoption frameworks that our team can confidently run on once your engagement concludes.

You’ll work directly with our leadership and operations team to audit our current processes, recommend a clean architecture (Workspaces, Spaces, Folders, Lists, and Statuses), and build out the structures, templates, automations, and reporting we need to manage book summary production, freelancer coordination, marketing campaigns, and cross-team projects.

We value both the skills and dedication of our team. We’re looking for someone proactive, inquisitive, and confident enough to speak up—even when it’s tough. To support a strong outcome, we will provide context, access, and decision-makers on demand so you can move quickly.

You’ll have access to stakeholders, but success here requires independence, accountability, and initiative. We expect you to take ownership of the build, do your own research when needed, and adopt a “whatever it takes” attitude to deliver a system our team will actually use.



What we expect:

- Share feedback, ideas, and insights to improve our operations

- Recommend tools, integrations, or training to boost team impact

- Contribute creative thinking on workflow design and automation

- Stay focused on practical, adoption-ready results that benefit the team

If that sounds like you—and you have the skills we need—we’d love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Workspace Audit & Architecture

• Audit our existing ClickUp setup (or current tools/processes) and identify gaps, redundancies, and opportunities.

• Design a scalable hierarchy of Workspaces, Spaces, Folders, and Lists that maps to how our teams actually work.

• Define standardized statuses, priorities, tags, and naming conventions across the workspace.



Workflow & Template Build-Out

• Build reusable task templates and list templates for recurring workflows (book summary production, marketing campaigns, editorial calendar, freelancer assignments, etc.).

• Configure custom fields, custom task types, dependencies, and relationships to reflect real-world handoffs.

• Set up forms for intake requests (e.g., new book titles, content requests, freelancer onboarding).



Automations & Integrations

• Build automations to eliminate manual hand-offs (status changes, assignments, due-date logic, recurring tasks, notifications).

• Configure integrations with our existing stack (Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Outlook, and other tools as relevant).

• Recommend and configure AI features within ClickUp where they provide clear value.



Dashboards & Reporting

• Build role-based dashboards for leadership, project managers, and individual contributors.

• Configure views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, Timeline, Workload) tuned to each team’s needs.

• Set up reporting on throughput, capacity, deadlines, and bottlenecks.



Documentation, Training & Handoff

• Document the workspace structure, conventions, and “how we work in ClickUp” so the team has a clear reference.

• Lead live training sessions (recorded) for tea
mbers and managers.

• Provide a clean handoff package so our team can confidently operate the system independently.



Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and administering ClickUp at the Workspace level (not just using it as an end user).

• Demonstrated track record of building ClickUp from scratch or overhauling existing setups for small-to-mid-sized teams.

• Deep knowledge of ClickUp features: Spaces, custom fields, custom task types, automations, dashboards, forms, docs, goals, and views.

• Experience designing workflows for content production, editorial, marketing, or media operations is strongly preferred.

• Strong process-design mindset—able to translate messy real-world processes into clean, scalable structures.

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to lead training and write clear documentation.

• Self-directed, responsive, and comfortable working with U.S.-based stakeholders.

• ClickUp Admin Certificate is a plus.

• Must have your own computer and a reliable internet connection.



Contract Terms

• Independent contractor engagement—defined-scope, project-based.

• Fixed project price agreed upon before kickoff, paid out in milestones tied to completion of agreed deliverables.

• 3-week project timeline with clear milestones and deliverables defined in a Statement of Work.

• Must provide your own computer and maintain appropriate tools for remote work.

• 
 will provide ClickUp admin access and any necessary credentials for integrated systems.

• Potential for ongoing retainer support after the initial build is complete.



Interview Process



If you would like to work with us on this project, respond directly to this job description with:

- A brief overview of your ClickUp consulting experience, including 1–2 examples of past workspace builds (anonymized if needed).

- Your proposed fixed price for a 3-week engagement of this scope, along with a suggested milestone breakdown.

- Links to any ClickUp certifications, portfolio pieces, references, or LinkedIn profile.

If we feel you may be a good fit, we will follow up with:

- A short discovery call (Zoom or Microsoft Teams) to walk through your experience and our needs.

- A scoping conversation to finalize deliverables, milestones, and pricing before signing a Statement of Work.

We’re hiring a dedicated Project Manager to push open projects across healthcare operations to completion. This role is equal parts project tracking, follow-up, documentation, and escalation. 



 



Your core job is to make sure nothing stalls: you will hawk-watch inboxes, outstanding requests, and “waiting on someone” items, and drive consistent follow-through until every project has a clear next step, owner, and deadline. We have meaningful dollars tied up in initiatives that don’t need more strategy—they need relentless execution management and accountability. 



 



This role requires familiarity with US revenue cycle management (RCM). Experience supporting litigation or legal workstreams is a strong plus. 



 



What You’ll Be Accountable For 



Every active project is documented in one place with: status, next step, owner, deadline, and dependencies 



No “silent stalls”: anything sitting in an inbox or awaiting a response is actively followed up until resolved 



Blockers are surfaced early with clear options and escalation paths 



Leadership receives a weekly summary that is decision-ready (what moved, what’s stuck, what we need) 



 



 



 



 



Key Responsibilities 



Maintain a master tracker of all active projects (status, next step, owner, deadline, dependencies); Notion preferred 



Proactively follow up on outstanding items with internal teams and external parties (payers, attorneys, vendors) 



Monitor “waiting on response” items and keep pressure on timelines through polite persistence 



Document new projects quickly and clearly (scope, goal, stakeholders, risks, expected outcome) 



Surface stuck items and escalate appropriately to leadership (what’s blocking, who owns it, what decision is needed) 



Sit in on or review key meetings and capture action items, owners, and due dates 



Run a weekly cadence for project follow-ups (agenda, notes, action items, and closure) 



Prepare weekly status summaries for leadership (wins, risks, blockers, aging items, next-week priorities) 



 



Requirements 



3+ years in project management, operations, or a similar coordination-heavy role 



Excellent written English (clear, professional, concise) 



Familiarity with US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) (claims lifecycle, denials, appeals, payer follow-up) 



Highly organized with strong follow-through and attention to detail 



Comfortable with Google Workspace and Microsoft tools; familiarity with Slack and standard PM tools (Notion preferred) 



Available for daily overlap with US Pacific Time (4–6 hours/day) 



 



Strong Plus 



Direct experience at a US healthcare, medical billing, or RCM company 



Experience supporting litigation or legal matters (document organization, exhibits, tracking deadlines, coordinating with counsel) 



Familiarity with CollaborateMD, QuickBooks Online, or similar systems 



Strong working knowledge of AI tools to increase efficiency (summaries, drafting, trackers, documentation) 



 



Compensation: TBD during final interview. 



 



 



How to Apply 



 



Please submit your resume and a brief note describing: 



 



Your project tracking system of choice (Notion, Asana, ClickUp, etc.) and how you run weekly follow-up cadence 



Your experience with US healthcare RCM (denials, appeals, payer follow-up) 



Any experience supporting legal or litigation-related workstreams

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality.



This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it.



Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you.



Key Responsibilities:

Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others.

• Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops.

• Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity.

• Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within.

• Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands.

• Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership.



Operating Model Design & Service Delivery

• Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities.

• Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows.

• Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice,
, chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores.

• Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist.

• Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement.

• Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked.



System Assessment & Service Technology Migration

• Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation.

• Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout.

• Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base.

• Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one.

• Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head.

• Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record.

• Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist.



Performance Management, Data & Reporting

• Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team.

• Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status.

• Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed.

• Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier.

• Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas.



Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance

• Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner.

• Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores.

• Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards.

• Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies.



Qualifications:

Required

• 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit.

• Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice,
, chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it.

• Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it.

• Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact.

• Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership.

• Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred.



Nice-to-Have

• Salesforce Service Cloud proficiency — case management, workflow rules, SLA configuration, omni-channel routing, and reporting.

• Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing.

• Workforce management platform experience (NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar).

• HIPAA familiarity and/or exposure to U.S. healthcare regulatory compliance operations.

• Track record of building or rebuilding operations within a high-growth or category-defining company.

• Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent contact center quality certification.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $18-$24/hr 

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment!



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process:

1. Your most updated resume.



2. Submit to all of these
s:

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Amazon OA Sourcing VA | 3P Mercury Experience a Plus
description:
Looking for an Amazon Online Arbitrage specialist focused on sourcing & database building. This is a singular-focus role: find great ASINs and build our Lead Vault. No POs, no operations, no logistics. Just sourcing.



We use 3P Mercury as our sourcing tool. If you have solid OA/Amazon sourcing experience, we'll train you on the tool. If you already know 3P Mercury, even better.



About Us

We run a growing Amazon Online Arbitrage business. This role handles sourcing and Lead Vault building exclusively. Your job is to find and add quality ASINs to the database. That's it.



What You'd Be Doing

Finding ASINs using manual sourcing techniques, reverse sourcing tools, and market research

Evaluating ASINs by checking sales velocity, profitability potential, competitive dynamics, and sourcing feasibility

Building & maintaining our Lead Vault by importing qualified ASINs into 3P Mercury with proper sourcing data

Validating sources by confirming product match, pack sizes, supplier legitimacy, and ongoing availability

Reporting on weekly/monthly database growth and sharing insights on trends

What We're Looking For

Must-Have:



? Hands-on experience with Amazon OA: you know sourcing, profitability math, and FBA dynamics

? Proven sourcing track record: you've found and sourced ASINs (any method is fine)

? Keepa proficiency: you can read charts, use Product Finder, and pull seller data

? Attention to detail: validating sources, confirming product match, pack sizes, supplier legitimacy. If you've read this far, make sure your application header starts with 3PM so we know you're paying attention.

? Fast, reliable internet and a quiet workspace

? Coachability: willing to learn our sourcing system and philosophy

Nice-to-Have:



? Experience with 3P Mercury (we have a complete training guide if you're new)

? Experience with ArbiSource (you'll have access and will be expected to use it)

? Familiarity with other reverse sourcing tools (Nepeto, Tactical Arbitrage)

? Experience with cashback stacking (BeFrugal, Rakuten, TopCashback)

? Knowledge of discounted gift card sourcing

Screening Questions

Please answer these in your application. We're assessing both your OA sourcing experience and your understanding of our approach.



1) Walk us through your sourcing process. What tools do you use? How many ASINs can you typically find and validate in a week? What criteria do you evaluate before d
 to source an ASIN?



2) Explain what you look for when evaluating an ASIN for profitability. What metrics matter most to you? Why?



3) What is the key difference between traditional OA sourcing and the 3P Mercury sourcing method? If you've used 3PM, explain how the approach works differently and why that matters. If you've never used 3PM, just write: never used 3PM.



4) What's your biggest challenge with sourcing? Where do you get stuck or lose time?



5) Why are you interested in this role? What appeals to you about focusing exclusively on sourcing and database building?



Note: We're looking for practical sourcing knowledge and someone who can explain their process clearly. Generic answers won't work.



Position Details

Type: Part-Time (flexible hours)

Schedule: Approximately 15-20 hours/week (negotiable based on performance)

Rate: Competitive, based on experience. Please include your desired hourly rate.

Location: Remote (Philippines-based preferred per OnlineJobs.ph)

Start: Flexible. We want to find the right person, not rush the hire.

Tools Provided: 3P Mercury access, Keepa subscription, any required sourcing tool subscriptions

How to Apply

Answer the 5 screening questions above, be specific and detailed

Share your relevant Amazon OA experience (years, types of businesses supported, tools used)

Describe your experience with 3P Mercury specifically: how long you've used it, what features you use most, and the size of the largest Lead Vault you've worked with

Include your desired hourly rate and available hours per week

We take applications seriously and ask that you do too. Please use 4 or more apply points when submitting. This helps us know you're genuinely interested in this specific role and not mass applying.

We're looking for someone with solid OA sourcing fundamentals. If you have 3P Mercury experience, great, you'll jump right in. If you don't but you're a solid sourcer, we'll train you on our system. We value coachability and attention to detail.

title: Global Sourcing & Supplier Development Manager
description:
Position Summary



We are seeking a highly skilled Global Sourcing & Supplier Development Manager to lead the identification, qualification, negotiation, and ongoing management of manufacturing partners throughout Asia and the Americas. This individual will play a critical role in securing competitive pricing, ensuring regulatory compliance, maintaining quality standards, coordinating packaging development, and supporting production execution.



The ideal candidate possesses strong international sourcing experience, exceptional negotiation skills, excellent English communication abilities, and an unwavering commitment to ethical business practices. This position works closely with the Director of Supply Chain Operations, who is responsible for forecasting and demand planning, to ensure products are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with all applicable regulations.



This is a strategic role responsible for protecting company interests, reducing risk, improving supplier performance, and maximizing value across the global supply chain.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Development

Identify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturers and suppliers globally.

Source products from factories throughout:

China

Vietnam

Thailand

Malaysia

Indonesia

Cambodia

Mexico

Central America

South America

Other emerging manufacturing regions

Conduct supplier capability assessments.

Develop and maintain a qualified supplier network.

Continuously identify alternative suppliers to reduce supply chain risk.

Benchmark market pricing and manufacturing costs.

Analyze global manufacturing trends, tariffs, freight costs, labor markets, and geopolitical risks.

Supplier Negotiations

Lead all commercial negotiations with factories and suppliers.

Obtain the most competitive pricing, payment terms, tooling arrangements, and production commitments.

Negotiate annual cost reductions where appropriate.

Develop leverage strategies among multiple suppliers.

Present sourcing recommendations supported by objective financial analysis.

Maintain detailed records of negotiations and supplier communications.

Quality & Supplier Performance

Coordinate supplier qualification and approval processes.

Monitor supplier quality metrics and corrective actions.

Work with factories to resolve quality issues.

Coordinate inspections and quality audits.

Ensure suppliers maintain required certifications and quality systems.

Track supplier performance including:

Quality

Delivery

Responsiveness

Cost competitiveness

Regulatory compliance

Regulatory & Compliance Management

Coordinate regulatory documentation and compliance requirements.

Maintain supplier records and certifications.

Support product registrations and regulatory submissions where applicable.

Ensure supplier adherence to:

FDA requirements

ISO standards

Product testing requirements

Labeling requirements

Country-specific regulations

Work with internal and external regulatory resources to ensure compliance.

Packaging Development & Product Commercialization

Coordinate packaging design projects with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Manage artwork revisions and approvals.

Ensure packaging complies with all applicable regulatory and customer requirements.

Coordinate packaging testing and validation.

Support new product launches from concept through commercialization.

Production Coordination

Collaborate closely with the Director of Supply Chain Operations.

Support production scheduling and manufacturing capacity planning.

Monitor factory production status.

Track manufacturing milestones and shipment readiness.

Escalate production risks proactively.

Help ensure products are delivered on schedule and in full.

Risk Management

Identify supply chain risks before they become disruptions.

Develop contingency sourcing strategies.

Maintain secondary supplier options where appropriate.

Monitor geopolitical, regulatory, tariff, and transportation risks.

Create mitigation plans for critical products.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, International Trade, or related field.

5+ years of international sourcing experience.

Experience sourcing products from Asia and/or Latin America.

Proven negotiation experience with overseas factories.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes.

Experience managing supplier relationships.

Experience with quality systems and supplier audits.

Strong financial and analytical skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to travel internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in regulated industries such as medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, consumer products, or industrial manufacturing.

Knowledge of quality management systems and supplier compliance programs.

Experience with packaging development.

Experience with product commercialization and product launches.

Experience conducting overseas factory audits.

Fluency in Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, or other relevant languages is a plus.

Critical Success Factors



The successful candidate will demonstrate:



Exceptional integrity and ethical conduct.

Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Data-driven decision-making.

Aggressive but professional negotiation skills.

Ability to challenge suppliers constructively.

Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities.

Strong attention to detail.

Ownership mentality and accountability.

Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision.

Fiduciary Duty, Ethics & Conflict of Interest Requirements



This position is held to the highest fiduciary and ethical standards.



The employee must always act solely in the best interests of the Company and its affiliated entities.



As a condition of employment:



The employee may not accept commissions, kickbacks, rebates, gifts, referral fees, overrides, consulting fees, or any other compensation from suppliers, manufacturers, brokers, trading companies, freight forwarders, consultants, or other third parties doing business with the Company.

The employee may not own, directly or indirectly, any financial interest in a supplier, manufacturer, broker, trading company, or service provider utilized by the Company without prior written disclosure and approval.

The employee may not participate in any purchasing, sourcing, supplier selection, or contract negotiation decision that presents an actual or perceived conflict of interest.

The employee must immediately disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest.

The employee must comply with all Company procurement, ethics, anti-bribery, anti-corruption, confidentiality, and supplier conduct policies.

All supplier recommendations must be based solely on quality, compliance, service, reliability, risk profile, and total cost of ownership considerations.

Any violation of these requirements may result in immediate termination and may subject the employee to legal action where applicable.

Confidentiality & Intellectual Property



Due to the strategic nature of this role, the employee will have access to confidential supplier information, product designs, pricing, sourcing strategies, forecasts, customer information, and other proprietary business information.



As a condition of employment, the employee must:



Execute a Confidentiality, Non-Disclosure, and Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement.

Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all Company information.

Return all Company records and materials upon termination of employment.

Assign to the Company all work product, supplier relationships developed on behalf of the Company, sourcing strategies, databases, specifications, packaging designs, processes, and intellectual property created during employment.

Refrain from using Company information for personal gain or for the benefit of any third party.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)



Success in this role will be measured through:



Annual cost savings achieved

Supplier quality performance

On-time delivery performance

Supplier responsiveness

Regulatory compliance performance

Successful product launches

Supply continuity and risk reduction

Packaging project completion

Inventory availability support

Negotiated improvements in pricing and payment terms

Supplier diversification and contingency planning effectiveness



This position serves as a trusted steward of the Company's global supply chain and is expected to consistently act in the Company's best interests while maximizing value, minimizing risk, and maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and integrity.

title: Content Creator & Creative Strategist
description:
We're a lemon law firm in California, USA and we're done with generic legal marketing.



We're building something different, and we need a creative who gets it.

This isn't a coordinator role. We're looking for someone who thinks in hooks, scripts content in their sleep, and actually understands why things go viral. We want someone who can help us build a content machine that educates, entertains, and generates real business.



You'll play a major role in our content strategy from concept to publish. Over time, we'll train the right person on paid media so you can eventually help manage advertising campaigns and take on a larger role in our marketing efforts.

What You'll Do

• Script, edit, and publish short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.

• Turn ideas, legal topics, and raw footage into engaging content that people actually want to watch.

• Write copy for social posts,
s, landing pages, and advertisements.

• Develop creative concepts, content calendars, and content strategies.

• Research trends, hooks, viral formats, and competitors.

• Track content performance and recommend improvements.

• Collaborate directly with firm leadership—no layers, no bureaucracy.

• Eventually assist with managing and optimizing Meta and TikTok advertising campaigns.



Who You Are

• You are fluent in short-form video and can prove it with a portfolio, client work, or your own social media accounts.

• You understand why some content gets ignored and other content gets millions of views.

• You write copy that actually moves people to take action.

• You understand the difference between content that entertains and content that converts.

• You are highly organized and can manage your own deadlines.

• You are hungry to learn paid media, marketing strategy, and eventually own larger parts of the customer acquisition process.

• You have excellent written and spoken English.



Bonus Points

• Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Canva, or similar tools.

• Experience managing social media accounts.

• Experience with Meta Ads or TikTok Ads.

• Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.



What We Offer

• Fully remote position.

• Full-time, long-term opportunity.

• Real ownership and influence over a growing brand.

• Direct access to decision-makers.

• Opportunity to learn paid advertising, funnel strategy, and performance marketing.

• Significant room for growth as the company expands.



How to Apply

Please send:

1. Your resume.

2. Links to content you have created or edited (your own account is fine).

3. A short note explaining why you would be good at making lemon law content interesting.



The word "HOOK" in the first line of your application so we know you read the entire posting.

We're not looking for someone who simply posts content. We're looking for someone who understands attention, storytelling, and what makes people stop scrolling and clicks on ads and opts in.

title: Senior DTC Meta Media Buyer – High-Growth Supplement Brand Remote | Full Time | Experienced
description:
Senior DTC Meta Media Buyer – Aviora

Aviora is building one of the fastest-growing supplement brands in the DTC space — and paid social is the engine behind it. We're now looking for an elite Meta media buyer to join our in-house team and own the performance of our paid campaigns from day one.

We don't guess. We test, we read data, and we scale what works. If you're the kind of operator who treats every dollar of ad spend as a decision — and can back every decision with numbers — we want to talk.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to profitably scale Aviora's customer acquisition through Meta paid social. You will own the full ad account — from campaign architecture and creative testing to budget management and performance reporting — ensuring we are consistently acquiring customers at or below target CAC while scaling spend efficiently.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own and manage Aviora's Meta ad account end-to-end across
 and Instagram

Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across prospecting and retargeting funnels

Develop and execute structured creative testing frameworks to identify winning angles, hooks, and formats at pace

Work closely with the creative team to brief, review, and iterate on static and video ad assets based on performance data

Monitor daily performance metrics and make proactive adjustments to bids, budgets, audiences, and creatives

Operate with a high degree of autonomy — you manage your account, flag issues early, and don't wait to be told what to fix

Maintain clear, proactive communication with founders and the executive team on performance, spend, and scaling decisions

Stay ahead of platform changes, algorithm shifts, and new Meta ad features — and apply them before competitors do





OUR TECH STACK



Ad Platform: Meta Ads Manager

Analytics: Triple Whale, Google Analytics, or equivalent attribution tools

Creative Management: Notion

Communication & Project Management: Slack & 





KPIs YOU WILL OWN



CAC: Customer acquisition cost at or below target threshold

ROAS: Campaign and account-level return on ad spend targets met consistently

Creative Velocity: New creative tests launched weekly — you move fast and keep the testing pipeline full

Spend Efficiency: Budget allocated and scaled in line with performance, no wasted spend sitting in underperforming ad sets





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven experience running and scaling Meta ad accounts for DTC or eCommerce brands — supplement or health/wellness experience is a strong plus

Demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably — we want to see numbers, not just titles

Deep understanding of Meta campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing methodology

Strong analytical instinct — you read data daily and make decisions from it, not gut feel

Experience briefing and collaborating with creative teams to produce performance-driven ad assets

An autonomous operator who owns outcomes, communicates proactively, and doesn't need hand-holding

Up to date on iOS privacy changes, Meta's evolving algorithm, and how to navigate attribution in a post-cookie environment





WHY JOIN AVIORA



Performance-Based Rewards: Bonus structure tied directly to account performance — when the numbers hit, you share in the upside

High Impact: You will have direct influence over the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling brand with a proven product

Work with the Best: Join a team of A-players across creative, video, and strategy who are all rowing in the same direction

High Autonomy: You own the account. We give you the budget, the creative team, and the trust — then we get out of your way

Growth Trajectory: For high performers, there are clear opportunities to step into a Head of Paid or Growth Lead role as the brand scales

Results-Driven Flexibility: We measure output, not hours. Be reachable during core hours (9AM–8PM ET), attend the Monday 12PM ET weekly call, and deliver results

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You prefer to set campaigns and check in weekly. This account needs daily attention, fast iteration, and sharp decision-making. If you're a passive manager, this isn't the right fit.

You struggle when platform rules change overnight. Meta's ad ecosystem shifts constantly — policy updates, algorithm changes, creative fatigue — and you need to adapt without losing 
ntum.

You see media buying as purely a numbers game with no creative involvement. At Aviora, the media buyer and creative team work closely together. You'll need to have strong opinions on what makes an ad perform, not just what makes it spend.

You want a stable, predictable workflow. We are scaling aggressively. Budgets move, priorities shift, and new opportunities need to be acted on fast. If that's stressful rather than energising, this isn't the right environment.



HOW TO APPLY

If you're an elite Meta media buyer who wants to own a high-growth ad account, work directly with founders, and be rewarded when the performance is there — we want to hear from you.

Answer all application questions thoroughly and show us specifically how your past results map to what this role demands. Numbers preferred over descriptions.

Include the code word 'DetailsMatter' somewhere in your application. We will only review candidates who follow this instruction. It's the first test.

 campaigns and announcements

 platforms

* Around 20 to 60 hours per week

* Spread across 5 to 6 days

* Fully remote and flexible

* Work to your own rhythm, as long as things get done



This suits freelancers who like consistent work without being locked into rigid hours.



Who This Is Great For



This role is ideal if you:



* Are a freelancer or contractor looking for a long term client

* Enjoy variety rather than doing the same task all day

* Like hospitality, travel, marketing, media, or tech

Growth & Pay



As your role expands and your impact grows, your rates will grow too. This is a relationship we want to invest in, not a short term stop gap.



How to Apply



Send us:



* A short intro about you

* A link to something you’ve worked on that you’re proud of

* Your hourly or project based rate



If you like being close to the action and want to grow alongside brands that are genuinely building something in this space, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Performance Video Editor
description:
**Performance Video Editor**



**Remote — Australia (Melbourne-based team) | Full-time, 38 hours/week AEST**



---



### **Not all editors make ads. The best ones make blinds look like the most exciting thing on the feed.**



We're 5 Minute Blinds. We sell custom-made blinds and curtains that Australians can measure, order, and install themselves in minutes, not weeks. We don't sell window coverings. We sell **taste**.



We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who can turn fabric, light, and transformation into scroll-stopping creative that actually drives sales.



---



### **About Us**



We're a Melbourne-based DTC brand reshaping how Australians buy window furnishings. Custom-made, expertly crafted right here in Australia, designed to be installed by anyone with a cordless drill.



We're growing fast across Meta, TikTok, Google, and Pinterest. Every room transformation, install demo, and fabric close-up is an opportunity to win a customer and we need an editor who treats it that way.



---



### **The Role**



This isn't a "make it look pretty" editing role. You'll sit at the intersection of creative and conversion, cutting video that stops thumbs mid-scroll, drives new customer acquisition and helps us achieve our mission of becoming the experts in the window furnishings industry.



You'll work directly with our performance marketing team, turning campaign data into creative decisions and shipping new ad variants at the pace performance media demands.



---



### **What You'll Actually Do**



- **Turn performance data into visual strategy** by working with the paid media team to understand what's converting (and what isn't), then design edits that double down on what works

- **Edit conversion-focused video** across Meta, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Shorts, Pinterest, and Google optimised for each platform's aspect ratios, sound conventions, and viewer behaviour

- **Master the 3-second hook** - our products are visual, but the feed requires virality. You'll craft openings that earn the next 30 seconds

- **Rapidly iterate and A/B test** design concepts based on performance data and real-time campaign feedback

- **Design scroll-stopping videos and motion graphics** that capture attention within 3 seconds and drive engagement

- **Participate in creative reviews** to analyse top-performing creative elements and extract replicable design principles

- **Multiply creative output through AI tools** — Leverage cutting-edge AI Technologies to enhance asset generation and production efficiency

- **Meet performance benchmarks** including click-through rates, engagement rates, and conversion metrics across all campaigns

- **Deliver assets on deadline** while maintaining quality standards and organised documentation systems

    

    ---

    



### **What Sets You Apart**



- **Proven experience** — Minimum of 2-3 years in a similar role. You've got a strong grasp of design fundamentals and know your way around Adobe Creative Cloud.

- **You analyse data before designing** — You don't just want to know what looks good; you want to know what converts and why

- **You've mastered rapid iteration** — You can produce multiple high-quality variants quickly, not precious about your work

- **You understand the psychology behind conversions** — You know why certain visuals trigger action and how to implement those principles

- **You can translate performance metrics into design decisions** — CTR, Hook Rate & CVR aren't just acronyms to you; they're design briefs

- **You think like a growth marketer, not just a designer** — You care about business outcomes, not just aesthetics

- **You make decisions fast** — You're comfortable with speed, can manage multiple projects, and deliver quality under tight deadlines



---



### **Why Join Us**



- **Real ownership of a fast-growing brand** — your edits will be seen by hundreds of thousands of Australians every week, and you'll see the revenue impact in real time

- **Work with purpose, Ideas become reality** — Create assets that drive real business results. We celebrate bold work and strong concepts get implemented quickly.

- **Learn constantly** — Gain expertise across multiple platforms and industries. Receive honest input that drives improvement through open discussion.

- **Creative autonomy** — We'll give you the problem, not micromanage your process

- **Flexible work arrangements** — Fully remote with core hours for team collaboration. Focus on results, not desk time, with freedom to structure your day (with core collaboration hours).

- **Supportive team culture full of A-players** — Our rigorous hiring ensures everyone on the team is exceptional while ensuring we win as a team.

- **Performance-based rewards** — We recognise and compensate exceptional results

- **Growth opportunity, Collaborative environment** — Help shape our creative approach as we expand. Knowledge sharing without creative politics or egos.



---



### **Ready to Prove You're in the Top 1%?**



Our hiring process is built to identify exceptional talent — quickly.



1. Apply with your resume and a portfolio/reel of performance work (please link to the actual ads, not just brand films)

2. Shortlisted applicants complete a trial performance editing project using real 5 Minute Blinds footage & creative brief

3. Finalists join us for a portfolio review and creative strategy discussion



**Applications without the completed project will not be considered.** This is intentional we're hiring on output, not credentials.

title: Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant — Property Manager / Co-Host
description:
Short-Term Rental Property Manager VA Job Post



Experienced Only — No Training Provided

?? Important: Do not apply if you have not personally used Hostaway, PriceLabs, Airbnb, or VRBO as a property manager or co-host. We will verify your experience with a skills test before any interview.



ABOUT THIS ROLE



We manage a growing portfolio of short-term rental properties and need a highly experienced VA who can hit the ground running with zero hand-holding. You will function as a full co-host and property manager — owning guest communication, listing management, pricing oversight, and operations from day one.



This is not a role where we will teach you the STR industry. If you do not already know the platforms, workflows, and guest experience standards at a professional level, please do not apply.



PLATFORMS YOU MUST KNOW BEFORE APPLYING



Hostaway

PriceLabs

Airbnb

VRBO

Truvi

Safely



DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES



Manage all guest communication in Hostaway — pre-booking, check-in, stay, checkout, and post-stay review requests — with professional, on-brand messaging

Monitor and respond to Airbnb & VRBO inquiries within SLA targets; handle objections and special requests confidently

Oversee PriceLabs settings, review pricing recommendations, flag anomalies, and make or escalate rate adjustments

Manage owner/guest insurance and damage claims through Safely and/or Truvi

Coordinate housekeeping, maintenance, and restock jobs through Hostaway task workflows

Keep listings optimized — photos, descriptions, amenities, house rules — across all OTAs

Flag negative reviews proactively and draft management responses

Manage owner reporting and reservation summaries as needed

Identify operational issues before they become guest complaints



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience as a STR property manager, co-host, or STR VA

Must have directly managed Hostaway (inbox, calendar, automations, task assignments)

Must have used PriceLabs — not just heard of it, but actively managed dynamic pricing settings

Strong written English — guest messages must be warm, clear, and professional without editing

Available during US business hours (Central or Eastern preferred); availability for weekend monitoring required

Reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps), backup connection preferred

Highly organized and detail-oriented — you will manage multiple properties simultaneously

Proactive communicator — you escalate issues before they become problems



APPLICATION SCREENING QUESTIONS



Answer all of the following in your application. Vague or generic answers will be disqualified.



1. How many months or years have you actively managed properties in Hostaway? Describe 2 specific tasks you perform in it regularly.



Why we ask: Rules out anyone who has only watched tutorials or used it briefly.



2. In PriceLabs, what is a Base Price Multiplier and when would you adjust it? What is a Min Stay override and why would you use one?



Why we ask: Anyone who truly uses PriceLabs can answer this immediately.



3. A guest messages at 10pm saying the WiFi is down and threatens a 1-star review. Write exactly how you would respond and what steps you would take.



Why we ask: Tests real guest communication skill and problem-solving under pressure.



4. Describe a specific mistake you made managing a STR property and how you handled it.



Why we ask: Anyone with real experience has made and learned from mistakes. Vague answers are a red flag.



5. What is your current availability in US Central or Eastern time? Are you available for weekend monitoring?



Why we ask: Non-negotiable operational requirement.



6. What is your internet speed and do you have a backup connection? (Paste a screenshot of a speed test if possible.)



Why we ask: Connectivity issues are a disqualifier for remote guest communication roles.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS



Full-time, long-term position — we are not looking for freelancers or part-time applicants

Competitive salary based on verified experience level

Performance bonus structure available after 90-day probationary period

Stable, growing company — we want someone who will grow with us



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and answer all 6 screening questions above in your application message. Applications missing answers to any screening question will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will receive a short practical skills test before any interview takes place.
